title: AI Native Creative Director - EdTech (French fluent )
description:
**What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?**

Then you’ll love this.

We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Director (Brand & Content).

Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.

**This isn’t another content job.** Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE CONTENT MEANS AT PARADOX**
-------------------------------------------

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our creative machine has to be able to:

**1. Read the signals.** Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.

**2. Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.

**3. Generate in our voice.** Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.

**4. Ship.** Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.

**5. Measure with real KPIs.** Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.

**6. Learn and loop on its own.** Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

**OUR MISSION**
---------------

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging:

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

**Short history**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy**

* Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
* Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
* Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
* The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
* At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.

### **2. Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery**

* Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
* Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
* Deliver what you pitch.
* The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
* At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.

### **3. Build the Content Factory: humans and agents**

* Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
* The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
* At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar.

### **4. Fuel the Growth Engine**

* Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works.
* The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything.
* At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human.

### **5. Go global, and keep the soul**

* We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated.
* And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:** you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.

**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE**
---------------------------------

**Experience :**

* Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers.
* Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes.
* Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics.
* AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**Traits :**

* Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces.
* Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them.
* A "Doer" with Authority: You command respect not by title, but by competence. You can jump into a project, write the script, direct the shoot, and fix the edit if needed.
* Loop thinker: you see every platform as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
* No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy.

**Language**

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

If you prefer balance over intensity: wrong season.

If you don’t genuinely care about the topics we cover: wrong place.

If you want to strategize without getting your hands dirty in scripting, directing, or the editing suite: wrong role.

If you think AI content means generic content: wrong role. We use AI to multiply what only we can make.

If you want to manage a large team: we’d rather build the machine than grow the headcount.

**WHY JOIN US**
---------------

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Build one of the first truly AI-native media, and write the playbook others will copy.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

**Growth & Ambition**

* > Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

**Competitive Salary**

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

**Impact & Meaning**

* > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
* > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

**Freedom & Well Being**

* > A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
* > Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
* > A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
* > Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices
* > Work on Mac, for us it counts :)
* > 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)

-> 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that

-> Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us

**HIRING PROCESS**
------------------

That job description resonated with you?

Here is your tailor made hiring process

A 6 to 8 minutes application survey, with links to content you made and something you built with AI

A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s content team

A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the creative vision and the next milestones to build

Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding

Welcome aboard!

**About our hiring process**

Our recruitment process is tailored to do our best to avoid that you or us realize that we’re not a perfect fit. Every step serves a purpose and will allow us to get to know you better as much as it’ll help you understand more where you’ll be stepping in.

We also want you to have time to ask all of your questions regarding the mission, the long-term vision of your team and the company, our values, with the relevant interlocutor in front of you.

If you’re not joining to post content.

If you’re here to build a media that changes how millions of people grow.

Welcome to Paradox.

Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

title: Creative Strategist Ads - Chile
description:
**Creative Strategist – Chile**
===============================

**Sobre Natulim**
-----------------

Natulim es una marca de productos de limpieza ecológicos que está experimentando un fuerte crecimiento internacional. Nuestra ambición es convertirnos en **la marca de referencia en Europa en el sector de la limpieza ecológica**, construyendo una marca DTC sólida, innovadora y cercana a sus consumidores.

Nuestro producto estrella son las **láminas de detergente biodegradables**, una alternativa más sencilla y sostenible a los detergentes tradicionales.

Actualmente operamos en distintos mercados internacionales y nuestro crecimiento se basa en una estrategia **DTC, data-driven y altamente orientada a resultados**, que combina Shopify, adquisición de clientes, contenido, CRM y una cultura de experimentación constante.

Somos un equipo joven, internacional y **remote-first**, donde cada persona tiene un alto nivel de autonomía, responsabilidad e impacto en el negocio.

Actualmente buscamos impulsar nuestro crecimiento en **Chile**, y para ello queremos incorporar a un/a **Creative Strategist** que conozca profundamente el mercado chileno y sea capaz de liderar nuestra estrategia creativa y contribuir al desarrollo del negocio en el país.

**El puesto**
-------------

Buscamos una persona **muy creativa, orientada a resultados y con una fuerte visión de negocio** para impulsar el crecimiento de Natulim en el mercado chileno.

El principal motor de crecimiento será la **creación, testeo y optimización de nuestras campañas publicitarias**. Por eso, necesitamos a alguien capaz de transformar insights de consumidores en ángulos creativos, conceptos publicitarios y contenidos que generen ventas.

Combinarás **creatividad y análisis de datos**: entender qué funciona, identificar por qué, desarrollar nuevas hipótesis y mejorar continuamente nuestro sistema creativo.

No buscamos simplemente a alguien que gestione un ecommerce, sino a una persona que sea capaz de **entender al consumidor chileno, identificar nuevos ángulos de comunicación y transformar la creatividad en crecimiento de negocio**.

**Tus responsabilidades**
-------------------------

### **1. Creative Strategy & Performance Ads**

* Analizar periódicamente el rendimiento de las campañas y creatividades para identificar los **ángulos, hooks, formatos y mensajes** que generan mejores resultados.
* Detectar nuevas oportunidades creativas a partir de datos, insights de consumidores, tendencias, competencia y cultura chilena.
* Desarrollar nuevas hipótesis creativas y proponer conceptos publicitarios adaptados al mercado local.
* Elaborar briefs creativos y colaborar con los equipos internos, creadores de contenido y partners para producir nuevas piezas publicitarias.
* Diseñar y testear diferentes ángulos, hooks, formatos, mensajes y propuestas de valor.
* Identificar qué elementos hacen que una creatividad funcione y transformar los aprendizajes en nuevas iteraciones.
* Construir progresivamente un **sistema creativo escalable**, capaz de generar nuevas ideas y creatividades de forma continua.
* Mantenerse al día sobre marcas DTC, tendencias en redes sociales y nuevas estrategias creativas en el mercado chileno.
* Trabajar estrechamente con el equipo de Paid Media para convertir los insights creativos en crecimiento y adquisición rentable.

### **2. Growth & Performance**

* Hacer seguimiento de los principales KPI de adquisición y rendimiento: **CAC, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, AOV, LTV**, etc.
* Comprender la relación entre el rendimiento de las creatividades, la adquisición de clientes y la conversión del ecommerce.
* Identificar puntos de fricción en el funnel y proponer acciones para mejorar el rendimiento global.
* Priorizar iniciativas en función de su impacto potencial en el negocio.
* Analizar los resultados del mercado chileno y transformar los datos en recomendaciones concretas.
* Testear, aprender, iterar y escalar las iniciativas que mejor funcionen.

### **3. E-commerce & CRO**

* Gestionar y optimizar la experiencia de compra en Shopify para el mercado chileno.
* Identificar oportunidades de mejora del **tasa de conversión, ticket promedio (AOV) y facturación**.
* Gestionar y optimizar productos, colecciones, promociones, packs, fichas de producto y landing pages.
* Proponer y coordinar experimentos y tests A/B.
* Identificar fricciones en el proceso de compra y colaborar con los equipos correspondientes para resolverlas.
* Garantizar una excelente experiencia de usuario, especialmente en dispositivos móviles.
* Contribuir a adaptar la experiencia de compra a las particularidades del consumidor chileno.

### **4. CRM & Retention**

* Coordinar campañas y automatizaciones de CRM a través de **Klaviyo**.
* Garantizar la coherencia entre las campañas de adquisición y el recorrido del cliente.
* Identificar oportunidades para mejorar la **retención, reactivación y LTV**.
* Colaborar con los equipos correspondientes para maximizar el valor generado por cada cliente.

### **5. Desarrollo del mercado chileno**

* Comprender en profundidad al **consumidor chileno**, sus necesidades, objeciones, hábitos de compra y comportamiento digital.
* Adaptar los mensajes, creatividades y propuestas de valor a la cultura y particularidades del mercado local.
* Identificar tendencias de consumo, oportunidades de crecimiento y referencias competitivas en Chile.
* Analizar cómo comunican y venden otras marcas del sector en el mercado chileno.
* Contribuir a posicionar Natulim como una marca reconocida y competitiva en Chile.
* Trabajar de forma autónoma, con ownership sobre el mercado, colaborando estrechamente con el equipo central ubicado en España.

**Perfil que buscamos**
-----------------------

* Experiencia en **ecommerce DTC, Growth, Creative Strategy, Performance Marketing o en posiciones similares**.
* **Ser chileno/a nativo/a y tener español nativo**, con un conocimiento profundo de la cultura, expresiones, hábitos de consumo y particularidades del mercado chileno.
* Residencia en Chile o conocimiento directo y actualizado del mercado local.
* Alta sensibilidad creativa y capacidad para generar ideas, ángulos y conceptos publicitarios.
* Experiencia en la creación, testeo u optimización de anuncios digitales.
* Conocimiento sólido de **Meta Ads** y de los principales canales de Performance Marketing.
* Capacidad analítica para interpretar resultados y transformar datos en insights creativos y de negocio.
* Comprensión de los principales KPI: **CAC, ROAS, CTR, CVR, AOV, LTV**, etc.
* Experiencia trabajando con Shopify u otras plataformas de ecommerce.
* Conocimientos de CRO, UX y optimización del funnel de conversión.
* Conocimientos de CRM y, preferiblemente, experiencia con Klaviyo.
* Capacidad para trabajar de forma hands-on, autónoma y con un alto nivel de ownership.
* Mentalidad emprendedora y capacidad para desenvolverse en un entorno dinámico y en constante evolución.
* **Inglés profesional**, para poder comunicarse y colaborar con el equipo internacional.

**¿Qué marcará la diferencia?**
-------------------------------

* Una auténtica **obsesión por la creatividad y las ideas que venden**.
* Experiencia en entornos DTC, startups o marcas de alto crecimiento.
* Experiencia desarrollando contenidos UGC, anuncios para redes sociales o sistemas de creative testing.
* Conocimiento de las tendencias digitales, creadores de contenido y códigos culturales del mercado chileno.
* Capacidad para pasar rápidamente de la **idea al concepto al test al aprendizaje a la iteración**.
* Mentalidad analítica sin perder la creatividad.
* Experiencia participando en el lanzamiento, posicionamiento o crecimiento de una marca en Chile.
* Capacidad para identificar oportunidades de mercado y convertirlas en iniciativas concretas de crecimiento.

**LOCATION:** Barcelona, Spain

### **A LITTLE BIT ABOUT THE ROLE AND TEAM**

Working in direct partnership with a leading European pet care client (part of a major international food group), the Senior Art Director will lead the visual craft, conceptual design, and art direction for four iconic pet care brands.

Embedded within our dedicated on-site agency hub in Barcelona, you will partner closely with a Senior Copywriter to form a powerhouse conceptual creative duo. Working directly with the client's Global Brand Teams, your focus will be upstream and platform-defining: translating global strategy into arresting visual ideas, distinct brand identities, hero campaign assets, and comprehensive global master toolkits designed for worldwide impact.

This role is built for a visually ambitious, craft-obsessed Art Director who thrives on conceptual storytelling, setting high aesthetic standards, and creating campaigns that celebrate the bond between pets and pet parents globally.

### 

### **WHAT IS REQUIRED**

* **Conceptual campaign ideation:** Partner with the Senior Copywriter to ideate, craft, and pitch big, multi-channel campaign platforms and visual territories for global briefs.
* **Global master toolkits & guidelines:** Architect and design comprehensive visual master toolkits, campaign playbooks, photography and motion style guides, and design systems for global rollouts.
* **Visual craft & execution:** Direct and craft high-end visual executions across the full campaign ecosystem, including brand films, digital and social activations, key visuals, print, packaging touchpoints, and retail/POS.
* **Art direction & shoot leadership:** Provide visual direction on film and photography shoots, collaborating with production partners, directors, photographers, and retouchers to bring creative concepts to life.
* **AI proficiency:** Comfort producing static images and videos with the help of different AI platforms is expected.
* **Client pitching & influence:** Present visual concepts, design rationale, and art direction territories directly to the client's Global Brand Directors and marketing leads with clarity and conviction.
* **Brand guardianship:** Ensure visual consistency, premium craft, and distinct identity separation across each of the four unique pet food brands.
* **Studio mentorship:** Collaborate with and mentor designers, artworkers, and junior creatives, elevating the overall design and art direction benchmark across the studio.

### **WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE**

* **Experience:** 6+ years of art direction and conceptual design experience within top-tier advertising agencies, design studios, or dedicated creative setups.
* **Portfolio:** An outstanding portfolio showcasing big-idea conceptual thinking, integrated global campaigns, impeccable typography, and modern digital and visual craft.
* **Sector background:** Experience working on FMCG, CPG, Pet Care, or lifestyle brands is highly desirable. Experience developing distinct visual worlds for multiple brands within a single portfolio is a strong plus.
* **Global campaign scope:** Demonstrated experience building global master toolkits, key visuals, and multi-market design systems (beyond local production and adaptation).
* **Technical mastery:** Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Figma. Experience with motion graphics and video editing tools (After Effects, Premiere Pro) or 3D/AI creative tools is a distinct advantage.
* **Collaborative chemistry:** Proven success working collaboratively in an Art Director / Copywriter team setup, with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
* **Languages:** Professional working fluency in Spanish and English is essential, as these are the working languages for both local and global briefs, and for the day-to-day relationship with the client team in Barcelona.

**About us**
------------

Creative Milkshake is a remote-first performance creative agency. We make scroll-stopping short-form ads for some of the world’s most exciting DTC brands on Meta and TikTok - high-volume, fast-moving, and built to convert.

We’re a close-knit team of ~34 people spread across the Netherlands, the Philippines, South Africa, Spain, and beyond. We’ve recently joined the Fieldtrip group alongside inBeat, which means we’re growing - in ambition, in capability, and in the complexity of clients we work with.

Our Amsterdam studio is the creative heart of our production operation. Over the next 1–2 years, we’re expanding from UGC-first content toward elevated branded formats, this role is central to holding the quality bar as we scale.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a **Senior Creative Strategist** to bring sharp thinking, bold ideas, and strategic mentorship to our team. You’ll partner with junior strategists on big projects, help steer creative in the right direction, and be the first layer of quality before ideas move forward to the Lead CS and Creative Director. You’re the kind of person who always has a pulse on what's next in ads, culture, and strategy.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

Here’s how we see your time being spent:

* 60% Creating CSPs/Creative Audits, Storyboards, leading client calls
* 20% Mentorship and collaboration with Junior Creative Strategists
* 20% Creative innovation: researching trends, platform updates, and developing new strategic frameworks

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Creative Strategy & Execution (60%)**

* Lead storyboarding and copywriting for mid-to-large projects.
* Lead and support on client and internal calls, bringing the right line of questioning to uncover insights.
* Review and refine briefs, references, and creative angles to ensure they align with brand goals and best practices.
* Turn performance data and brand insights into strong, clear concepts that convert.
* Collaborate with Account Managers, Production, and Design to keep ideas moving smoothly from concept to execution.

**Mentorship & Feedback (20%)**

* Schedule mentorship calls with Junior CSs or learning calls with the creative strategy team to level-up their work and creative thinking.

* You are the first layer of quality before the Lead Creative Strategist & Creative Director does their final approval checks.

* Be a key voice in spotting problems early and suggesting solutions before they escalate.

* Test and bring forward new frameworks, hooks, or structures to elevate our work.

* 3-5 years experience in creative strategy, copywriting, or paid social (agency or brand side).

* Strategic thinker with a love for performance-driven creative.
* Strong eye for quality — across copy, references, and creative structure.
* Proactive, solutions-oriented, and ready to own your projects.
* Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in a fast-moving, collaborative environment.
* Always curious about what's next in advertising, storytelling, and social platforms.
* CET, GMT or +/- 1 timezone required.

**Skills**
----------

* Copywriting & storytelling for ads
* Social-first creative strategy (esp. direct response)
* Trendspotting & strategic innovation
* Collaborative leadership
* Problem solving & ownership mindset
* Comfortable in Google Drive, Slack, ClickUp, Foreplay, Motion

* Creative Milkshake Stipends (mental health, healthcare & internet)

description:
**About the Company**
---------------------

We are a fast-growing international consumer goods brand focused on developing innovative and sustainable cleaning products. Our ambition is to make sustainable cleaning more accessible to consumers through convenient, effective and environmentally conscious alternatives to traditional household products.

We operate across several European markets, combining a direct-to-consumer (DTC) business model with a data-driven and highly performance-oriented approach. Our growth is driven by creative production, paid acquisition, e-commerce and a culture of continuous experimentation.

We are a young, international and **remote-first** team, where everyone has a high level of autonomy and ownership. We are now looking to accelerate our growth in **Italy**, a strategic market for our business.

**The Role**
------------

We are looking for a **highly creative, performance-driven and consumer-oriented person** to become the creative engine behind our growth in the Italian market.

**Creativity is at the heart of this role.** We are looking for someone who can deeply understand the Italian consumer, identify compelling communication angles and turn insights into **advertising concepts, hooks and creatives that capture attention and drive sales**.

Your main responsibility will be to develop, test and continuously improve advertising creatives, identifying new ways to communicate our value proposition and stand out in the market. You will combine creative thinking with performance analysis, using data to understand what works, generate new ideas and improve the effectiveness of our campaigns.

We are not simply looking for someone who can manage an e-commerce business or analyze marketing data. **We are looking for a creative thinker who knows how to turn ideas into advertising that sells.**

Experience in areas such as e-commerce, CRO, CRM or broader Growth is a plus, but **your creative mindset, ability to generate strong advertising concepts and understanding of performance-driven creative strategy are what matter most**.

**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **Creative Strategy & Performance Ads**

* Develop creative concepts and advertising angles tailored to the **Italian market and consumer**.
* Identify new ways to communicate the company's value proposition, product benefits and competitive advantages.
* Generate compelling **hooks, messages, storytelling concepts and creative formats** that capture attention and drive conversions.
* Research Italian consumer behaviour, cultural insights, social media trends, competitors and successful advertising approaches to inspire new creatives.
* Develop creative hypotheses and translate them into actionable concepts for paid advertising.
* Create clear and effective **creative briefs** for internal teams, content creators, UGC creators and external partners.
* Explore different creative approaches, including UGC, testimonials, product demonstrations, problem-solution concepts, educational content and other performance-driven formats.
* Collaborate with the Creative and Paid Media teams to produce, launch and test new advertising creatives.
* Analyze creative performance to understand which hooks, angles, messages and formats work best, using these insights to generate new ideas and improve existing concepts.
* Continuously iterate on successful creatives, finding new variations and opportunities to scale their performance.
* Build a **repeatable and scalable creative testing system** that consistently generates fresh ideas and advertising assets for the Italian market.
* Ensure that advertising feels authentic and relevant to Italian consumers, rather than simply translating campaigns from other countries.

### **Creative Performance & Growth**

* Monitor creative and campaign performance to understand which concepts generate the strongest results.
* Use relevant KPIs such as **CTR, CPA, CAC, ROAS and CVR** to evaluate creative effectiveness and inform new hypotheses.
* Identify the relationship between creative messaging, audience response and conversion performance.
* Work closely with the Paid Media team to understand campaign results and turn performance insights into new creative opportunities.
* Prioritize creative initiatives based on their potential impact on acquisition and business growth.
* Test, learn, iterate and continuously improve the creative strategy based on results.

### **E-commerce, CRO & CRM**

Although creativity is the main focus of the role, experience in other areas of digital growth would be a valuable advantage.

* Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate across the Italian e-commerce experience.
* Contribute ideas to optimize product pages, landing pages, promotions, bundles and value propositions.
* Understand how creative messaging connects with the website experience and influences conversion.
* Contribute to CRO initiatives and A/B testing by identifying opportunities to improve the customer journey.
* Support the alignment of advertising creatives with CRM campaigns and customer communications.
* Experience with **Shopify, Klaviyo, CRO, UX or retention marketing** is a plus.

### **Italian Market Insights**

* Develop a strong understanding of the **Italian consumer**, including their needs, motivations, objections, purchasing habits and perceptions of sustainable household products.
* Identify local insights, cultural nuances and consumer pain points that can inspire effective advertising concepts.
* Research Italian competitors, DTC brands, social media trends and relevant creative approaches.
* Identify opportunities to differentiate the brand and strengthen its positioning in the Italian market.
* Bring new ideas and creative perspectives to the wider team, helping adapt the company's communication to local consumer expectations.

**About You**
-------------

* **Native Italian speaker** with professional English proficiency.
* A strong creative mindset and the ability to generate original, compelling and commercially relevant ideas.
* A genuine interest in advertising, consumer psychology, storytelling and understanding what makes people pay attention and buy.
* Ability to turn consumer insights into **creative angles, hooks, concepts and advertising messages**.
* Understanding of social media content and digital advertising formats, particularly Meta Ads.
* Ability to think beyond standard advertising approaches and propose fresh ways to communicate a product's value.
* Understanding of performance-driven creative principles, including testing different concepts, analyzing results and iterating based on learnings.
* Ability to combine creativity with analytical thinking and use data to improve creative decisions.
* A proactive, hands-on and autonomous approach to work.
* Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, international environment.
* **Experience in Creative Strategy, content creation, digital advertising, performance marketing or a related creative role is desirable.** We are open to different professional backgrounds as long as you can demonstrate strong creative thinking and potential.

Experience with Shopify, e-commerce management, CRO, CRM or Klaviyo is a plus.

**What Will Make You Stand Out**
--------------------------------

* A genuine **obsession with creative ideas that sell**.

* Experience developing creative testing frameworks or iterating on ads based on performance data.
* The ability to move quickly from **insight idea concept creative test learning iteration**.

**About JumpSeat**
JumpSeat is a hybrid creative agency + advisory organization working alongside B2B marketing and revenue teams to drive growth.
  
  
We're a remote-first crew across the US, Buenos Aires and Italy. We care about bold, specific work, and about the people who make it.
  
  
****The role****
We're looking for a Senior Art Director / Brand Designer to join our creative team.
  
  
You'll be part of Story, our brand and creative practice. It's where we help B2B companies find the story only they have the right to tell, then make it easier to sell and harder to ignore. That covers brand development, solution storytelling, and creative campaigns, all built from the market signals we uncover for our clients.
  
  
You'd sit somewhere between a classic Art Director and a brand designer. You'll get a strategic or conceptual brief, find the idea in it, build a visual world around that idea, and then see it all the way through to the finished piece. Think key visuals, campaign identities, and brand systems that still look great on every touchpoint.
  
  
You'll have a lot of autonomy here. We trust you to make good creative calls without someone looking over your shoulder. When feedback comes in, we want you to get what's really behind it, not just tick off the comments.
  
  
You'll also help us figure out how AI fits into the way we create. We're excited about new tools and use them to explore more and move faster. But the idea, the taste, and the final call? Those stay with people.
  
  
If you've got a strong portfolio across both branding and campaigns, we'd love to talk.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
****Find the idea.****

* Take strategy and messaging and turn them into visual concepts bold enough to stand out. Buyers ignore generic, and so do we.
* Explore a few different creative directions, share them, and know which one is worth fighting for.
* Bring real Art Direction thinking to every brief, not just great execution.

****Build brands that scale.****

* Design full brand identities and visual systems that help clients own a position competitors can't claim, not just a logo here and a one-off piece there.
* Lead brand refreshes that move things forward without losing what people already recognize.
* Make sure every system has the depth and flexibility to work wherever it ends up.

****Bring campaigns to life.****

* Create campaign concepts, key visuals, and campaign identities from a blank page, including ABM programs and thought leadership that give accounts already in motion a reason to engage.
* Take one big idea and carry it across websites, decks, social, paid media, events, and whatever comes next.
* Sweat the details: typography, layout, composition, color, and hierarchy.

****Create with AI, lead with judgment.****

* Use AI to go wider when you're exploring, test ideas quickly, and speed up production.
* Keep the concept in the driver's seat. The tools should serve the idea, not decide it.
* Edit hard and refine by hand until it feels like the brand and meets our bar.
* Share what's working with the team, because the tools keep changing and we learn faster together.

**Who You Are**

* You're a Senior Art Director or Brand Designer with 7+ years under your belt, ideally from a strong agency or studio.
* You think in concepts first. You can tell us the idea behind a project before you show us a single frame.
* You've created original key visuals and campaign identities, not just adapted someone else's.
* You love building systems, and you've designed complete brand systems with real depth.
* You're a little obsessed with craft: typography, layout, composition, color, and visual hierarchy.
* You're independent and decisive. You can go from brief to direction without needing your hand held.
* You're great with feedback. You use it to make the work better instead of applying every comment literally.
* You're curious about new tech, AI included, and you have the eye to tell what's actually good.
* You're fluent in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.
* You're comfortable working in English with a remote, multicultural team.

****Nice to have****

* You've used AI image, video, or design tools in your own creative work.
* You've worked at an agency or consultancy across different industries.
* You've done integrated or multi-channel campaigns.
* You've designed for websites and digital.
* You have a feel for motion and animation.
* You're a confident presenter who can stand behind the work.

**What We'd Love To See In Your Portfolio**
We care more about how you think than how many projects you've done. So show us:
  
  

* The idea behind each project.
* How a key visual grew into a full campaign system.
* The directions you explored, not just the one that won.
* Brand systems with depth, and how they play out across formats.
* Consistent, high craft.
* Where you used AI, what you kept, and what you threw out. We love seeing process work.

**How We'll Get To Know You**

* A chat with our Talent team.
* A portfolio review, where you walk us through two or three projects from idea to execution.
* A practical case, where you show us how you'd tackle a real-world creative challenge.
* A conversation with some of our senior team.

**What's In It For You**

* Real influence. You'll shape how our brands and campaigns look, and how we create them.
* Great people. A team that will challenge you, inspire you, and have your back.
* Remote first. Colleagues across the US, Buenos Aires, and Italy.
* Balance, for real. Unlimited PTO, Summer Firdays, time off between holiday, and more.

****Ready to take the seat?****
No safe stories. If you want to own both the idea and the craft, we'd really like to hear from you.

**What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?**

Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.

**This isn’t another content job.** Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

  

**WHAT AI-NATIVE CONTENT MEANS AT PARADOX**
-------------------------------------------

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our creative machine has to be able to:

**1. Read the signals.** Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.

**2. Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.

**3. Generate in our voice.** Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.

**4. Ship.** Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.

**5. Measure with real KPIs.** Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.

**6. Learn and loop on its own.** Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

  

**OUR MISSION**
---------------

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging:

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)

* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)

* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

**Short history**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

  

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

  

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy**

* Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
* Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.

### **2. Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery**

* Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.

* The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.

  ‍
* + ️ At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.

### **3. Build the Content Factory: humans and agents**

* Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
* The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.

  ‍
* + ️ At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar.

### **4. Fuel the Growth Engine**

* Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works.
* The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything.

  ‍
* + ️ At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human.

### **5. Go global, and keep the soul**

* We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated.
* And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:** you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.

  

**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE**
---------------------------------

**Experience :**

* Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers.
* Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes.
* Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics.
* AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**Traits :**

* Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces.
* Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them.
* A "Doer" with Authority: You command respect not by title, but by competence. You can jump into a project, write the script, direct the shoot, and fix the edit if needed.
* Loop thinker: you see every platform as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
* No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy.

**Language**

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

  

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

If you prefer balance over intensity: wrong season.

If you don’t genuinely care about the topics we cover: wrong place.

If you want to strategize without getting your hands dirty in scripting, directing, or the editing suite: wrong role.

If you think AI content means generic content: wrong role. We use AI to multiply what only we can make.

If you want to manage a large team: we’d rather build the machine than grow the headcount.

  

**WHY JOIN US ️**
-----------------

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Build one of the first truly AI-native media, and write the playbook others will copy.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

**HOW TO APPLY**

title: Creative Director (Video Ads)
description:
**Why should you join Jerry?**

* Join a pre-IPO startup with capital, traction, and runway ($240M funded | 40X revenue growth in 4 years | $2T market size).
* Disrupt a massive market and help scale us to a $5B business in the next few years.
* Be immersed in a talent-dense environment and accelerate your career growth exponentially.
* Build the team, systems, and creative engine behind Jerry’s video output, from concept through final cut.

**About the Role**

At Jerry, we are redefining and radically improving how people manage car ownership, one of their most expensive and time-consuming assets. Backed by artificial intelligence and machine learning, Jerry simplifies and automates car ownership while providing personalized services tailored to all car owners’ needs. We are the #1 rated and most downloaded app in our category with a 4.7-star rating in the App Store and more than 5 million customers — and we’re just getting started.

We’re looking for a Creative Director who thinks in systems. You know how to design a creative operation that produces high-performing video at scale, and how to find, hire, and develop the people who make it run. You bring a strong creative point of view and a good eye, but you know great output comes from the right team and the right process. Your work will span TikTok, Meta, YouTube, and CTV. You’ll partner with growth, media, and creative leadership to build an engine that keeps getting better, and AI and new media will be core parts of how it works.

**Why you will (or won’t) like working here:**

* **Large canvas:** There’s no set-in-stone playbook here. You’ll design how our video creative function works: team structure, workflows, testing frameworks, and the talent bar.
* **Builder, not maintainer:** This isn’t a role where you manage a team that already exists. You’ll shape the team from the ground up, decide what talent we need, and go get it.
* **Car ownership is not “sexy”:** Insurance, maintenance, and safety are only topics people think about when they have a bill to pay or a flat tire to change. Can you build a team and a system that creates enthusiasm and trust around a “dry” topic? That’s the challenge here.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build and lead a small, nimble video creative team. You’ll define the roles, set the hiring bar, and attract and develop the talent we need to scale.
* Design the creative system: repeatable workflows, briefing structures, testing frameworks, and feedback loops that turn performance data into better creative, faster.
* Set creative direction and quality standards across paid social, CTV, and emerging channels, so the brand stays strong as volume grows.
* Build frameworks for hooks, angles, and concepts based on what actually drives performance, and teach the team to use and extend them.
* Bring AI into how the team works (ideation, scripting, editing, asset generation, etc.) to increase output and expand creative range.
* Partner with media, growth, and analytics teams to connect creative strategy to business outcomes and set shared priorities.
* Stay hands-on when it matters: concepting, giving sharp creative feedback, and editing directly when speed or quality needs it.
* Track platform trends, formats, and cultural shifts, and build that awareness into how the team operates.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 8+ years in video creative, art direction, or production at a performance agency, in-house growth team, or content studio, including time building or leading creative teams.
* **Systems thinking:** you’ve designed creative processes, workflows, or testing frameworks that scaled output without lowering quality.
* **Team-building and talent judgment:** you know what great creative talent looks like, how to recruit it, and how to structure and develop a team around it.
* A proven track record of video creative for paid channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, CTV, etc.) that drove measurable results.
* **Performance creative fluency:** you understand what makes people stop scrolling (hooks, pacing, CTAs) and can teach it to others.
* **Strong creative and visual judgment:** you have an eye for composition, pacing, and brand quality, and you can raise the team’s work through direction and feedback.
* Video editing fluency, so you can step in and cut when needed.
* **AI fluency:** you experiment with generative tools and think about how they change team workflows, not just individual output.
* **Bonus:** experience in both performance and brand creative, and a clear point of view on how craft and conversion can coexist.

**Why This Role Matters**

Jerry’s creative team has proven it can drive performance, and now we’re ready to scale. This role is a chance to build the creative engine that powers Jerry’s growth. You’ll define how we work, decide who we hire, and set the bar for what great looks like, combining craft, data, AI, and media strategy. The team and systems you build will reach millions of people.

*While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.*

Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.***

We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.*

*Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at* *recruiting@jerry.ai*

Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.*

*We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.*

**About Jerry.ai**

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

title: Creative Director
description:
Description:

More than a decade ago, Ledge introduced America to the first-in pool chaise and modern

design forward furniture for a more compelling outdoor living experience. Today the award-

winning brand is recognized as the in-pool and poolside leader, adopted by discerning

homeowners and five star resort and residential properties around the world.

Our continued success is very much a consequence of our team members, the Ledge culture of

collaboration and innovation, and our unwavering belief in the importance of design distinction

in everything we do.

If you are committed to your growth, collaborative both in spirit and action, and seeking to join

a high performing team that both works hard and plays hard, we encourage you to apply.

**Job Overview**

At Ledge, we believe outdoor spaces are not just extensions of the home - they are living works

of art. We are seeking a Creative Director to make Ledge unmistakable and show customers why

our designs belong in their outdoor spaces.

This is a hands-on leadership role that owns how Ledge looks, sounds and makes people feel

across campaigns and customer touchpoints. You will set creative direction, design finished

work, coach our in-house team, and lead outside partners to deliver compelling product stories

for homeowners and Ledge Contract buyers. You will also own creative workflow and

production budgets while advancing our use of photography, 3D visualization, and AI-assisted

production. This position reports to the Chief Marketing and eCommerce Officer.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set creative direction and evolve the brand. Define the visual and verbal standards that make Ledge distinctive, and use the strongest new work to keep brand guidelines current.
* Develop campaign concepts and design finished work. Translate audience needs and product features into clear stories, personally carrying selected pieces from initial layout through final artwork.
* Lead creative execution across channels. Guide the team in adapting concepts for launches catalog, paid media, email, and other touchpoints while maintaining a consistent brand experience.
* Build and coach the creative team. Provide clear briefs and actionable feedback, develop capabilities, and manage a roster of trusted freelancers, agencies, and specialists.
* Own creative workflow, capacity, and production budgets. Align work with the commercial calendar, establish clear scope and approval responsibilities, and deliver approved assets by agreed handoff dates.
* Art-direct photography and 3D production. Select locations, styling, lighting, and composition that showcase each design, and ensure imagery accurately represents product scale, finishes, and features.
* Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted techniques where testing demonstrates better creative work or faster production. Maintain quality and product accuracy across all output.
* Partner with Marketing, eCommerce, Product, Sales, and CX to refine product stories, review creative performance, and apply customer feedback and test results to future briefs.
* Maintain an organized library of approved assets.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Clear product storytelling. Creative helps customers understand what makes a Ledge design distinctive and worth owning, informed by feedback from Sales and CX.
* A distinctive and consistent brand. Reviewed campaigns meet the creative standard agreed with Marketing, bring fresh ideas, and depict products accurately.
* Reliable launch and campaign delivery. All agreed assets are ready by channel handoff dates, with on-time delivery tracked against the commercial calendar.
* Disciplined production spending. Shoots, freelancers, and agency work stay within approved campaign budgets, with scope and spending changes addressed early.
* More efficient creative production. Time from approved brief to final assets improves for comparable projects as workflow, staffing, 3D, and AI techniques are tested and refined.

Requirements:

* 8+ years of experience in design, advertising, or a related creative discipline, including work for a premium or lifestyle brand.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating both hands-on design and creative direction, with clear attribution of work personally created versus work directed.
* Experience advancing an established brand while preserving its recognizable strengths and translating product features into compelling customer stories.
* Experience coaching designers and leading in-house teams and external partners from brief through final delivery.
* Ability to manage production budgets, creative capacity, deadlines, and stakeholder approvals across concurrent projects.
* Experience art-directing photography and 3D visualization, with the judgment to evaluate photorealism, product accuracy, and AI-assisted output.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and presentation skills, including the ability to explain creative decisions and give specific, constructive feedback.

*Portfolio submission: Include a campaign that moved an established brand forward, finished*

*pieces you designed yourself, and work you directed. Explain what you kept, what you changed,*

*how you judged the result, how you staffed the work, and one decision involving photography,*

*3D, or AI.*

At Ledge, we value diversity and inclusion and are committed to providing equal employment

opportunities to all individuals. We offer a competitive salary, benefits package, and the

opportunity to work with a dynamic team in a positive and supportive work environment.

title: Creative Director

This role is responsible for establishing the creative vision, developing and maintaining high-performing design teams, and translating consumer and trend insights into commercially successful products for mass retail customers.

The ideal candidate is not only an exceptional creative thinker, but also a proven people leader who has successfully lead teams, created scalable processes, and driven accountability across a design organization.

The Creative Director oversees Design Managers and Designers while partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Product Development, Sourcing, Marketing, and Retail partners to bring compelling seasonal and everyday collections to market.

Creative Vision & Strategy

* Establish a clear creative vision across all brands, categories, and retail channels.
* Translate macro consumer, lifestyle, and trend insights into actionable product strategies.
* Connect trend forecasting to retailer needs, customer behavior, assortment opportunities, and business objectives.
* Define seasonal creative direction, color strategy, materials, forms, finishes, and key visual storytelling elements.
* Ensure all creative output reflects both brand positioning and commercial viability.

Team Leadership & Development

* Lead, coach, and develop Design Managers. Coach Design Managers to ensure they lead high performing teams of Designers.
* Set clear expectations, accountability, and performance standards.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct talent reviews, succession planning, hiring, and professional development planning.
* Mentor emerging creative leaders and build organizational capability.

Creative Excellence & Accountability

* Establish creative standards and ensure design excellence across all categories.
* Lead creative reviews and provide actionable feedback that elevates work.
* Create clear ownership structures and decision-making accountability.
* Ensure teams move efficiently from concept through execution.
* Balance creative innovation with speed, business objectives, and operational realities.

Trend-to-Product Translation

* Own the organization’s trend forecasting process.
* Establish repeatable frameworks for trend research, competitive shopping, consumer insights, inspiration gathering, and product translation.
* Guide teams in converting trends into product concepts, assortments, graphic assets, packaging, and brand storytelling.

title: Social Content Lead | Poppy & Peonies
description:
Bloom is a full-service workplace design consultancy, proudly supporting Poppy & Peonies in their search for a Director of Brand & Social to join their dynamic team. As Talent Advisors, we serve as the bridge between our Bloom Partner and you throughout the recruitment process. At Bloom, we don’t rely on automated tools to sift through applications—every resume is carefully reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. If selected, you’ll join Poppy & Peonies directly as a valued member of their team. We’re excited to consider your application! Please note that applications will be accepted throughout the holiday season. Thank you for your patience and interest in this opportunity!

Hi, I’m Natalie Dusome, Founder and CEO of Poppy & Peonies, a fun and energetic brand that believes styles and function should co-exist. We’re passionate about creating practical pieces that help make life a little easier and lighten the load, literally.

Building Poppy & Peonies has been a wild adventure. The journey began when my daughter Poppy was born and my accessories no longer worked with my new life as a mom, I needed bags with pockets and organization that looked cool and had functionality. I couldn’t find it, so I decided to create it, and in 2015 Poppy & Peonies was born.

We’ve come a long way in five years – from filling orders in my basement to appearing on Dragons’ Den, and now, expanding into new product categories and collaborating with some exciting influencers and brands. I’d be lying if I said it’s been nothing but smooth sailing, but thanks to our incredible community, we’ve never felt more loved and supported!

We believe in our responsibility to care for our environment and we are passionate about preserving the health and welfare of our planet, and the animals that live on it. All of our bags are made from high-quality vegan leather, and our entire product line is vegan, cruelty-free, and PETA-approved. We ship our products plastic-free and we use a combination of recycled, compostable, and biodegradable materials to mitigate shipping waste, and we are constantly looking for new ways to make our products and supply chain more sustainable to reduce our carbon footprint.

**About The Role**

  

Poppy & Peonies is one of the fastest-growing accessory brands in Canada, and social is where most people meet us first. We're looking for a Social Content Lead who doesn't just manage our channels — they create what makes people want to follow them.

  

You're a creator at heart. You see content opportunities in everyday moments, have a camera roll full of ideas, and know how to turn a passing conversation into something worth watching. You're just as comfortable in front of the camera as you are behind it, and you can take an idea from concept to final edit without missing a beat.

  

You have a strong creative point of view, an instinct for what's culturally relevant and an understanding of what makes a brand feel like part of someone's world rather than another advertisement in their feed.

  

You think in Reels, TikToks, carousels and Stories. You've shot content, cut the edit that same afternoon and watched it outperform the campaign asset. You understand the importance of data, but you're equally comfortable trusting your creative instincts and trying something new.

  

Working closely with our Director of Brand & Social, you'll help shape how Poppy & Peonies shows up across social — from the idea, to the shoot, to the post, to what we learn from it. Your goal is to create content that builds brand affinity, grows our audience and brings our community closer to the brand.

### **The Opportunity**

**Create**

* Concept, shoot, edit and publish original, social-first content across Instagram, TikTok and emerging platforms.
* Be a regular on-camera presence for Poppy & Peonies, bringing our products, brand personality and storytelling to life in an authentic and engaging way.
* Develop fresh creative concepts, recurring content series and recognizable social formats that feel distinctly Poppy & Peonies.
* Create a thoughtful mix of product storytelling, styling content, entertainment, educational content, founder and team moments, and behind-the-scenes experiences.
* Be on set for brand shoots and content days, capturing platform-native content and ensuring social is considered throughout the creative planning process.
* Collaborate with photographers, videographers, models and creators to develop content that feels native to each platform.
* Write compelling hooks, captions, scripts and on-screen copy that reflect the Poppy & Peonies voice.
* Move comfortably between planned campaign content and spontaneous, reactive content opportunities.

**Stay Close to Culture**

* Stay immersed in social platforms, internet culture, fashion, lifestyle and the conversations shaping our community.
* Identify emerging trends, formats, audio and cultural moments, moving quickly on opportunities that feel authentic to the brand.
* Bring a strong creative point of view on what Poppy & Peonies should participate in, what we should sit out and where we can create something entirely our own.
* Draw inspiration from culturally relevant brands, creators and communities, both within and outside our industry.
* Experiment with emerging platforms, features and storytelling formats to keep our content fresh and relevant.

**Grow**

* Partner with our Director of Brand & Social to bring the organic social strategy to life.
* Own the social content calendar across product launches, campaigns, partnerships and always-on storytelling.
* Monitor content performance, including reach, saves, shares, watch time, audience growth, traffic and conversion, translating insights into creative decisions.
* Continuously experiment with hooks, formats, storytelling approaches and content styles, building on what resonates with our audience.
* Collaborate with Influencer, Ecommerce and Creative teams to ensure social supports broader brand and commercial objectives without losing its authenticity.

**Build Community**

* Create content that encourages conversation, participation and a genuine sense of connection with the brand.
* Work closely with our Community Coordinator to understand what our audience is talking about, asking for and responding to.
* Translate community insights into relevant content ideas, storytelling opportunities and feedback for the wider team.
* Build meaningful relationships with creators and ambassadors, identifying opportunities for collaborative content that feels natural and engaging.

**Collaborate & Lead**

* Support and develop the social and community team as the function continues to grow.
* Foster a collaborative creative environment where ideas are encouraged, explored and brought to life.
* Balance creative experimentation with organization, consistency and the ability to execute at pace.
* Build simple, scalable processes for content planning, production, approvals and performance reporting.

### **What You Bring to the Table**

* You bring experience creating social-first content for a consumer brand, creative agency or through your own established creator platform.
* You're a natural storyteller who is confident and comfortable appearing on camera, speaking to an audience and bringing a brand's personality to life.
* You can independently concept, shoot and edit compelling short-form video content, with proficiency in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar editing tools.
* You have a strong eye for visual storytelling, styling, composition and brand aesthetics.
* You understand internet culture and have an instinct for what makes content engaging, relatable, shareable and worth coming back for.
* You have demonstrated experience growing an engaged social audience and can speak to both the creative thinking and performance behind your work.
* You understand the nuances of Instagram and TikTok and how to create content that feels native to each.
* You use performance insights to inform creative decisions while remaining curious, experimental and willing to take creative risks.
* You have experience collaborating with creators, influencers and creative teams.
* You're organized, resourceful and comfortable balancing multiple creative projects in a fast-moving environment.
* You have a genuine interest in fashion, accessories, lifestyle and the communities surrounding them.

**We'd Love to See Your Work**

  

Alongside your application, please share a portfolio, social channels or examples of content you've personally concepted, created, filmed or edited.

  

We're interested in seeing your creative point of view, your storytelling ability and how you've brought ideas to life. Whether that's through your work with a brand, your own social platforms or independent creative projects, we'd love to see what you make and how you think.

### **The recruitment process**

* Video screen with Talent Advisor from Bloom
* Video Interview with Thuy, Art Director
* Video Interview with Abby, CMO
* Final Interview with Natalie Dusome, CEO + Founder of Poppy & Peonies
* Reference checks
* Offer

Applications will be accepted through the end of November. Candidates can expect to hear from us regarding next steps by November 30th 2026.

### **Location**

* We’re seeking an exceptional candidate based in the US or Canada who values the flexibility of remote work while embracing the excitement of in-person experiences.
* There will be occasional domestic and/or international travel for photoshoots, events, and team retreats.

### **Salary and Total Rewards**

* Health benefits coverage
* $250 annual period & menstrual budget

We encourage you to share your desired compensation early in the interview process, but we also understand that as you learn more about the role and the full benefits package, your expectations might evolve. Don't worry - there will be plenty of opportunities throughout the process to revisit and adjust those conversations if needed.

We’re looking for motivated, compassionate people who are excited to contribute, grow with the team, and support the values that Poppy & Peonies believes in.

Poppy & Peonies is committed to developing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. Please inform us if you require any accommodation, and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs. Requests for any accessibility-related assistance can be made to sarah@buildwithbloom.com.  
  
**We believe transparency matters, especially as technology evolves.**  
  
At Bloom, we may leverage AI as a supportive tool when developing role descriptions, interview questions, take home assignments, and interview guides, where appropriate, with the goal of improving clarity, consistency, and accessibility for candidates. However, we do not use AI to source, assess, screen, or interview candidates. Every application is reviewed by a human, every interview is conducted by a human, and all hiring decisions are made by people, not automated systems. Human judgment, care, and accountability are central to how we hire.  
  
**About Bloom**  
  
**Bloom** is a full-service workplace design consultancy representing Poppy & Peonies at they build their team. As Talent Advisors, we will be the liaison between our Bloom Partner and yourself during this recruitment process. We do not use fancy tech to search through resumes at Bloom; every resume is reviewed by a human to ensure that we attain a consistent and equitable interview process. You will directly join our client’s team if you are selected as the successful candidate. We look forward to seeing your application!
