The CDI Training & Education Manager supports the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of clinical education, nursing development, quality learning initiatives, and patient education programmes across CDI. The role contributes to strengthening clinical competence, supporting quality and patient safety standards, enabling workforce capability development, and supporting the implementation of structured clinical career pathways and leadership development initiatives. The role also helps ensure regulatory compliance and the delivery of high-quality, patient-centered care by embedding consistent education, competence expectations, and learning standards into practical tools and programmes.  
Under the leadership and strategic direction of the Associate Director, the role actively contributes to shaping the competence environment across nursing and clinic staff populations by translating strategic education priorities into practical curricula, competency frameworks, learning pathways, tools, and implementation support across countries and clinics.  
The position operates in close collaboration with Nursing & Quality, Operations, HR, and multidisciplinary stakeholders to support harmonized learning approaches, competency development, and educational consistency across countries and clinics, while ensuring alignment with CDI strategic priorities and the CDI Blueprint.

Key Responsibilities  

* Support the design, development, implementation, and continuous update of nursing, clinical staff, quality, and patient education programmes, curricula, competency frameworks, and learning materials aligned with clinical standards, regulatory requirements, and organisational priorities.
* Actively contribute to the development and regular updating of competency frameworks, role-based curricula, learning materials, and structured learning pathways to support consistent clinical competence and professional development across nursing and clinic staff populations. This includes maintaining materials over time so that education content remains current, practical, and aligned with evolving clinical guidance and organisational priorities.
* Coordinate and support the delivery of education and training initiatives using blended learning methodologies, including classroom-based learning, virtual sessions, simulation activities, workplace-based learning, and digital learning solutions. The role should actively translate learning needs into fit-for-purpose delivery formats that can be adopted by countries and clinics.
* Create, update, and manage educational content within Learning Management Systems (LMS), including e-learning modules, competency assessments, structured learning pathways, learning records, and training documentation.
* Support onboarding programmes, role-based competency development, mandatory training activities, and continuous professional development initiatives for nursing and clinical populations.
* Contribute to the implementation and ongoing support of leadership development programmes and workplace-based learning initiatives to enhance staff development, student/staff learning experience, and local capability building.
* Support the design, implementation, and promotion of clear clinical career pathways, contributing to skill development, staff progression, retention, succession planning, and professional growth within clinical environments.
* Collaborate with Nursing & Quality, Operations, HR, clinic leadership, and multidisciplinary stakeholders to identify learning needs, clinical practice gaps, competency gaps, quality improvement opportunities, and workforce development priorities.
* Support the monitoring and evaluation of training effectiveness through participation metrics, competency validation, learner feedback, quality indicators, patient care outcomes, and operational outcomes.
* Create, review, update, and support the implementation of patient education materials and programmes, ensuring accessibility, cultural appropriateness, alignment with clinical guidance, and patient-centered care principles. This includes supporting countries with practical implementation and adaptation where needed, while ensuring consistency with central clinical guidance.
* Lead and coordinate harmonization and sharing of best practices, educational standards, tools, and learning approaches across countries and regions where applicable.
* Participate in regional and international projects related to clinical education, workforce capability, nursing development, quality initiatives, and patient education.
* Provide practical input, tools, and implementation support to countries and clinics to help embed consistent competence expectations, education practices, and learning standards, while escalation, strategic prioritisation, and final governance remain with the Associate Director.

Educational Background & Professional Experience  

* Registered Nurse with current or previous clinical practice experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in Nursing, Healthcare, Education, Healthcare Management, or a related clinical field required.
* Master’s degree or additional qualification in Clinical Education, Adult Learning, Leadership, Healthcare Quality, Organisational Development, or related disciplines is considered an advantage. Practical teaching experience in clinical or adult education settings is also considered an asset.
* Experience within dialysis, renal care, hospital, clinical operations, healthcare quality, nursing development, or regulated healthcare environments is considered an advantage.
* Experience working in multicultural and international healthcare environments and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders is preferred.
* Exposure to competency management, workforce capability development, clinical onboarding, career pathway frameworks, healthcare learning programmes, or LMS-based education environments is considered beneficial.

Required Profile  

* Strong clinical and healthcare background with experience in nursing, clinical education, healthcare training, workforce capability development, or quality-related environments.
* Proven ability to work within matrix and cross-functional organisations supporting operational and educational initiatives across different stakeholder groups.
* Understanding of clinical governance principles, patient-centered care approaches, and healthcare quality standards.
* Typically 4–6 years of professional experience in nursing, clinical education, healthcare training, workforce development, or related healthcare learning environments.
* Proven experience developing, delivering, and maintaining nursing education, clinical training, competency development, professional development initiatives, and/or patient education programmes.
* Experience working with digital learning tools, Learning Management Systems (LMS), e-learning content, competency assessments, and blended learning methodologies.
* Understanding of competency frameworks, clinical education approaches, quality standards, workforce capability development, and clinical career pathway implementation within healthcare environments.
* Strong organisational, communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage diverse clinical and non-clinical audiences. The role should be able to translate technical clinical content into clear learning approaches for both clinical and non-clinical audiences.
* Ability to work across functions, countries, and multicultural environments.
* Strong operational coordination skills with the ability to support multiple initiatives and priorities simultaneously.
* Fluent English required; additional languages are considered an asset.

title: Coordinator Entrepreneurship & Innovation Center – Labs Team
description:
Overview:

Are you interested in joining a dynamic and international team of professionals to transform education? IE University's **Entrepreneurship & Innovation Center** is looking for a **Coordinator** to join its team!

The Entrepreneurship & Innovation Center at IE University is hiring a Coordinator to support an Associate Director (AD) across their portfolio of student programs, helping with the day-to-day operations of three of these programs: Search Funds Lab, VC & PE Lab, and Real Estate Lab.

This is an execution-focused, highly hands-on role: it keeps the day-to-day of each program running — calendars, sessions, student communication and events — so the AD can focus on stakeholders, budget and program direction.

**Why IE University?**

Every story begins with a purpose, and ours has always been about people. Founded in 1973, IE University has continuously raised the bar to drive positive change through education. We believe education is more than a path to professional success; it is a catalyst for personal transformation and meaningful impact.

At IE University, we place people and their potential at the center of everything we do, empowering individuals to become extraordinary. We encourage bold thinking and foster a culture where innovation, curiosity, and courage lead to real-world impact. Together, we create an environment where talent thrives, and ideas shape the future.

**Our mission**

We support students in developing impact skills to live and lead with positive impact. This ignites a ripple effect: We transform people, who then transform others, systems, society, and, ultimately, our world.

**Our Purpose**

To foster positive change.

**Values**

* Cultivate the humanistic approach.
* Empower your entrepreneurial spirit
* Cherish the diversity of people, mind, and experience
* Drive innovation with a proactive mindset

We are looking for a person to join a full-time position in **Madrid - Velázquez.**

Responsibilities:

**Your role as a Coordinator will involve:**

This person will be working side by side with the Associate Director, in the same fast-paced environment, handling the operational and front-line work that keeps the 3 Labs running smoothly day to day. What will the Coordinator do?

* **Program administration:** send calendar invites, schedule room bookings, follow up on sessions and attendance, and keep trackers up to date across all 3 Labs.
* **Student-facing support:** answer day-to-day student queries directly and with good judgment; escalate incidents or anything sensitive to the AD rather than resolving them alone.
* **Events & logistics:** organize sessions and events end to end — book rooms, arrange catering and other vendors, coordinate on-site logistics; pass the resulting invoices and paperwork to the Center's assistant for payment processing.
* **Communication pieces:** create emails, slides and other communication pieces for students and events, consistent with the Center's brand and wording.
* **Front-office support:** support and, where appropriate, deliver informational sessions to students about the programs and upcoming events.
* **Process feedback:** flag what isn't working and suggest practical improvements to the AD, as input into process design — process ownership stays with the AD.
* **Occasional support to fellows/interns:** help on specific tasks when asked by the AD; day-to-day management of fellows/interns stays with the AD.

  
Qualifications:

**To thrive in this role, you should possess the following qualifications**

**Education:**

University degree in business, communications, event management or a related field is highly recommended.

**Professional Experience:** +1-3 years of experience in a coordination or operational role (program, event or office), ideally with multiple moving parts and deadlines running at the same time.

**Nice to have:** experience at a higher education institution, or exposure to the startup/innovation ecosystem (incubators, accelerators, venture events).

**Skill area**

**What it looks like in this role**

Organizational accuracy and attention to detail

Coordinating many moving parts (calendars, rooms, sessions, trackers) across 3 Labs at once, without dropping details.

Student-facing communication

Handling queries with judgment, care and a consistent tone; knowing what to resolve directly and what to escalate to the AD

Event & logistics execution

Booking rooms and vendors (e.g. catering), coordinating on-site logistics, and solving problems in real time during an event

Content & communication pieces

Producing clear, on-brand emails, slides and other materials for students and events

Front-office delivery

Comfortable speaking to groups and representing the Center in informational sessions

Administrative reliability

Accurately compiling and handing off invoices and paperwork to the Center's assistant; audit-ready recordkeeping

Process-mindedness

Noticing inefficiencies on the ground and feeding back practical suggestions, without owning process redesign

Communication and brand

Excellent written and spoken English and Spanish (C1 or higher); clear, on-brand communication

Digital fluency

Comfort with CRM, scheduling and collaboration tools, and the curiosity to adopt new ones

Mindset

Proactive, service-oriented, resourceful and adaptable in a fast-moving, front-line environment

**Knowledge you should bring:**

* A thrive for entrepreneurship and innovation.
* Event and community management practices.
* Basic familiarity with the startup and investment landscape (incubators, accelerators, mentors, investors) is a plus.

**Success in this role** means flawless day-to-day execution across the 3 Labs: nothing falls through the cracks on calendars, rooms or sessions; students get fast, reliable answers; events run smoothly; and the AD can rely on the Coordinator as a trusted operational partner.

**We offer** hands-on exposure across 3 Labs, direct contact with students, mentors and events in the entrepreneurship ecosystem, and an international, fast-moving environment.

Unleash your full potential and make an impact. The next move is yours!

If you want to be part of this educational revolution, we invite you to apply and be part of our dynamic team at **IE University.**

title: Presenter - GCN en Español
description:
**Department:**

GCN en Español

 **Contract:**

Fixed-term cover, February – July 2027

**Location**

: You’ll be based in Girona

**Reporting to**

:

Director of Pro Cycling in the UK

**Job purpose**
---------------

To represent GCN en Español on and off screen, creating and presenting engaging, entertaining and informative cycling content for our Spanish-speaking audience.

The role will involve being a key on-screen personality for the channel, presenting a wide range of video formats, from cycling news and race analysis to technical features, product testing, challenges and practical cycling advice.

The successful candidate will also contribute to the creative development of the channel, researching and pitching ideas, writing scripts, planning content and working closely with the wider production team to deliver videos that engage existing viewers and attract new audiences.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about cycling, knowledgeable about the sport and its industry, confident in front of the camera and able to bring personality, insight and energy to our content.

**Purpose / mission of the department**
---------------------------------------

To grow GCN en Español as a leading destination for Spanish-speaking cycling fans around the world.

This means growing our audience, views and subscribers, while continually developing the breadth, quality and appeal of our content. We aim to inform, entertain and inspire cyclists through original, relevant and engaging video content covering all aspects of the sport and cycling culture.

**Success outcomes (within the fixed-term contract)**
-----------------------------------------------------

By the end of the contract, the successful candidate will have:

* Successfully integrated into the GCN en Español team and established a strong rapport with the existing presenters and production team.
* Confidently presented and contributed to a variety of the channel's regular content and social formats.
* Researched, developed and pitched original ideas that have been progressed into engaging video content.
* Demonstrated the ability to independently research, script and present content to a consistently high standard.
* Contributed to the growth and engagement of the GCN en Español audience through compelling, relevant and entertaining content.
* Represented the channel professionally at cycling events, races and industry activities where required.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Presenting and content creation**

* Be one of the key faces and voices of GCN en Español, representing the channel on camera and across its various platforms.
* Present a wide range of content, including cycling news, technical features, product reviews, challenges, entertainment, interviews and practical advice.
* Bring energy, personality, humour and authenticity to presentations, helping to create an engaging relationship with our audience.
* Research, develop and pitch original content ideas that reflect the interests of our Spanish-speaking cycling audience.
* Write scripts, prepare presentations and work with producers and other team members to plan and deliver content.
* Take ownership of individual video projects where appropriate, from initial idea and research through to filming and delivery.
* Actively engage with the GCN en Español audience across social media platforms, helping to build a strong and loyal cycling community.

### **Cycling knowledge and technical content**

* Present informative and engaging technical content, including bike and component reviews, product comparisons, testing and explanations of new cycling technology.
* Present practical how-to content covering bike maintenance, riding techniques, training, fitness and cycling skills.
* Demonstrate products and techniques both in the studio and out on location, providing viewers with useful, accessible and credible advice.
* Use personal cycling knowledge and experience to provide insight, context and credibility to the content.
* Keep up to date with developments in the cycling industry, new products, trends and innovations.

### **Racing and industry coverage**

* Research and present cycling news, race reports and analysis, particularly around major professional stage races and one-day events.
* Present technical and feature content from professional cycling races and other industry events.
* Use industry contacts to arrange and conduct interviews with professional riders, teams, mechanics and other key figures in cycling.
* Help bring the stories, personalities and developments from the professional peloton to life for our audience.
* Attend race events and other locations as required to produce relevant and engaging content.

### **Teamwork and channel development**

* Work closely with International Content Creators, Production team and other presenters to ensure content aligns with the channel's objectives and overall GCN strategy.
* Collaborate with other GCN channels and the wider Play Sports Network team where opportunities arise.
* Contribute positively to the creative culture of the team, sharing ideas and supporting the development of new formats and content opportunities.
* Assist other members of the GCN team as and when required.

### **Commercial Content and Partner Relationships**

* Present branded and sponsored content for GCN en Español, working with commercial partners to deliver engaging video content that meets agreed campaign objectives.
* Work collaboratively with the commercial, production and editorial teams to develop creative ideas and concepts for partner-led content.
* Confidently integrate brand messaging, products and key campaign messages into video content in a natural, engaging and authentic way.
* Present product demonstrations, reviews, sponsored features and other commercial formats while maintaining the tone, personality and credibility of GCN.
* Build positive working relationships with commercial partners and represent GCN professionally during filming, events and other partner-facing activities.
* Understand the importance of delivering content that meets both audience expectations and commercial commitments.

**Skills, experience and attributes**
-------------------------------------

**Essential:**

* An elite-level road cyclist, comfortable demonstrating riding techniques and participating in cycling challenges and features.
* Good knowledge of, and contacts within, professional road cycling and the cycling industry, with knowledge of its equipment and technology.
* Passionate about cycling, with understanding of its overall culture and audience.
* Native/fluent Spanish speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Good ability in spoken and written English to communicate effectively with the wider Play Sports Network team, the majority of which are based in the UK.
* Confident and engaging on camera, with the ability to communicate information clearly and naturally.
* Creative, curious and able to generate interesting and original content ideas.
* Research, scriptwriting and storytelling skills.
* Flexible, organised and able to work effectively in a fast-paced production environment.
* A positive team player who can also work well independently and take ownership of projects.

**Desirable:**

* Previous experience presenting video or digital content.
* Experience in journalism, broadcasting, video production or content creation.
* Experience presenting technical cycling content, product reviews or race coverage.

You will join our office in Madrid, working closely with internal teams while directly engaging with partners, providers, and venues across the market.

description:

**The Role:**  
The **Content Producer – FIFA** is responsible for creating and producing high-quality football content across multiple platforms, with a particular focus on social media and digital audience engagement.

The role develops, shoots and produces original content, transforming editorial ideas and storytelling opportunities into compelling, innovative and relevant pieces that connect with football fans across different markets. * Appear on-camera to deliver football-related content in a unique and engaging manner.
* Manage social media accounts, posting timely updates and interacting with followers.
* Monitor football trends, breaking news and league developments to provide real-time coverage.
* Collaborate with designers, video editors and other content creators to produce high-quality content.

* Fluent in English and Spanish (written and oral)
* Proven experience in content creation, social media management or sports journalism.
* Comfortable presenting in front of the camera with a distinctive and engaging style.

* Exceptional writing, editing and storytelling skills.

Prioritising what matters drives progress and positive outcomes, **Focusing On Impact.**

Collective ambition builds optimism and success, in order to **Win As One.**

description:
**Company Description**

***Why are we here?***

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

 **Job Description**

**In a nutshell**

The Senior UX / Product Experience Designer is a hands-on individual contributor within our IT Section, supporting dedicated Product Managers and Business Analysts on selected high-priority initiatives across the Laboratory Information Management System for Food and Environment Testing (eLIMS-NG) and the Customer web portal (DOL). The role combines user research, service design, interaction design and usability evaluation to identify opportunities for improvement, validate proposed solutions and support evidence-based product decisions.

Supporting Product Managers, the person in the role will produce customer journeys, mock-ups, prototypes and other design artefacts that improve the user experience and support analysis and delivery of product increments.

The role will also contribute with the exploration and application of AI-powered design tools and other technologies to make journey mapping, mock-up creation and other design activities more efficient. Through practical training, coaching and knowledge sharing, you will support the product organisation in adopting these tools and embedding user-centred design techniques into everyday ways of working.

**Where will you be based and what business will you support?**

The job location is based in Madrid (Spain), Barcelona (Spain) or Nantes (France), with a hybrid working arrangement.

Reporting to the Head of IT Product Management, the role will support two digital products: eLIMS-NG, the laboratory information management system, and DOL, the customer web portal.

Occasional travel to Eurofins laboratories or other offices may be required to support user research, usability testing and collaboration with international teams.

**How can you help us?**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Focused user research for priority initiatives:**

* Conduct focused user research, interviews, contextual observations and usability testing where needed to support selected high-priority initiatives to understand user needs, behaviours, goals and pain points.
* Work with dedicated Product Managers and relevant laboratory or customer representatives to involve the right users in project-specific research and design validation.
* Identify practical opportunities to improve user satisfaction, usability, efficiency and adoption within the agreed scope of priority initiatives.
* Translate research findings into clear, evidence-based recommendations and opportunities for product improvement.

**Service design and user journeys:**

* Create customer and user journey maps for selected initiatives across DOL and eLIMS-NG, working alongside the dedicated Product Managers and Business Analysts.
* In time, build and maintain a catalogue of end-to-end user journeys across eLIMS-NG and DOL.
* Map current user journeys and, where appropriate, develop service blueprints to understand interactions between users, business processes, applications and supporting activities.
* Identify pain points, unnecessary complexity, hand-offs, workarounds and opportunities to simplify the user experience.
* Use journey maps, process flows and other visual artefacts to communicate findings and support cross-functional alignment.
* Help ensure that product improvements consider the wider end-to-end experience rather than isolated screens or individual requirements.

**Interaction design and usability:**

* Review navigation, workflows, information presentation and interaction patterns relevant to selected priority initiatives.
* Produce mock-ups, wireframes, interaction designs and prototypes that help Product Managers and Business Analysts analyse requirements, explore and communicate potential solutions and support delivery.
* Validate proposed designs with users before significant development investment, iterating based on feedback and observed behaviour.
* Provide actionable recommendations to Product Managers and Business Analysts, supporting the translation of user needs into clear business and user requirements.
* Create high-fidelity user interface designs that translate validated user needs into intuitive, efficient and visually coherent experiences.
* Apply principles of layout, typography, visual hierarchy, information architecture and interaction design to improve usability and reduce cognitive load.
* Collaborate with software engineering teams to assess design feasibility and support the implementation of validated solutions, without owning software implementation.

**Teams' collaboration and product development:**

* Work closely with Product Managers and Business Analysts to incorporate user research and experience design into discovery, requirements analysis and product lifecycle management.
* Work alongside the dedicated Product Manager and Business Analysts on selected initiatives, contributing design expertise and artefacts.
* Collaborate with business process experts, business operational excellence teams, deployment teams, laboratory representatives and other IT teams to understand business processes and user needs.
* Support the assessment of requirements by identifying the underlying user problem, challenging assumptions and exploring alternative solutions where appropriate.
* Facilitate workshops and collaborative design sessions to align stakeholders around user needs, pain points and potential improvements.
* Balance user needs with business objectives, process standardisation, technical feasibility and relevant regulatory constraints.

**UX capability development and continuous improvement:**

* Explore, evaluate and apply AI-powered design tools and other technologies to make customer journey mapping, mock-up creation and day-to-day design activities more efficient.
* Champion user-centred design and service design practices within Product Management, helping teams adopt more effective discovery and validation techniques.
* Coach Product Managers and Business Analysts in user research, journey mapping, usability evaluation and evidence-based problem solving.
* Train and coach Business Analysts through practical demonstrations, guided exercises and feedback so they can use design tools and techniques independently.
* Identify and introduce practical improvements to the product team's ways of working, including reusable templates, examples and lightweight design guidance without adding unnecessary documentation or process overhead.
* Encourage a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, constructive challenge and solution-oriented thinking.
* The performance of the role is assessed through:
* The timely delivery, quality and usefulness of customer journeys, mock-ups, user research and other design artefacts for selected initiatives.
* The identification and validation of opportunities to improve usability, user journeys and operational efficiency.
* Practical efficiency improvements from AI-powered design tools and other technologies, and Business Analysts' increasing ability to create effective journeys and mock-ups independently.
* The ability to collaborate effectively with product teams and stakeholders across both supported products.

  
**Qualifications**

**Are you our kind of extraordinary?**

**Skills needed:**

* Strong knowledge of user-centred design, service design, UX research and interaction design principles.
* Proven ability to conduct user research and usability testing, synthesise findings and translate them into practical recommendations.
* Experience creating user journey maps, service blueprints, wireframes and interactive prototypes.
* Ability to analyse complex business processes and workflows, identifying usability issues and opportunities for simplification.
* Hands-on proficiency with modern UX and design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD or equivalent, together with technical curiosity and the ability to evaluate and apply existing AI-powered tools to practical design tasks (i.e. Github copilot)
* Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to explain design rationale and influence stakeholders without direct decision-making authority.
* Ability to train and coach non-specialist colleagues, explain design principles accessibly and help Business Analysts build confidence in journey mapping and mock-up creation.
* Ability to challenge established practices constructively, remain open to different perspectives and propose practical solutions to improve the status quo.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with Product Managers, Business Analysts, business process experts, software engineering teams and users across different countries and cultures.
* Ability to balance user needs with business objectives, technical feasibility and operational constraints.
* Comfortable working in an Agile or hybrid product development environment and using digital collaboration and design tools.
* Professional proficiency in English. Additional languages (such as French, German and/or Spanish) are an advantage.

**Experience Requirements:**

The Senior UX / Product Experience Designer will contribute directly to priority project delivery while helping colleagues adopt practical design tools and techniques. The candidate should fulfil:

* A bachelor's or master's degree
* 6+ years of relevant experience in UX, Product Design or Service Design, including substantial hands-on experience in user research and interaction design.
* Proven experience improving complex digital products and workflows through research, usability evaluation and iterative design.
* Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and translating research findings into validated design recommendations.
* Experience using modern design tools, with an interest in applying AI-powered tools and emerging technologies to improve design workflows and productivity.
* Experience sharing knowledge, coaching colleagues or introducing new tools and ways of working within a multidisciplinary team.
* A portfolio showcasing relevant UX, service design and user interface design work, including examples of research, journey mapping, interaction design and delivered digital experiences.
* Experience working with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders in complex business or operational environments.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and make progress in ambiguous problem spaces.
* A collaborative, open-minded and solution-oriented approach, with the confidence to challenge existing ways of working constructively.

**What can we do for you?**

This role offers the opportunity to contribute hands-on from the outset and introduce new ways of working for an established product organisation. As the organisation evolves, there is potential to grow into broader Product Management responsibilities and, over time, people leadership.

We are offering the following:

* A competitive salary package
* Extensive on-the-job coaching and training opportunities.
* Challenges within a multi-cultural and cross-regional team as part of the international and fast-growing Eurofins organization.
* A dynamic working environment with a good team spirit where personal development and growth are highly encouraged.

**What else should you know?**

As the role and Eurofins' teams are international, please ensure to submit your application in English Language.

 **Additional Information**

**We support your development!** Do you feel like you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

**We embrace diversity!** As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Eurofins network of companies believes in strength and innovation through diversity. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Find out more on our Careers page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

**Company description:** Eurofins Scientific is an international network of independent life sciences companies, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.  
The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.  
  
In under 40 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 employees across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in over 1,000 independent companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.  
  
The Eurofins network generated EUR 7.296 billion revenues in FY 2025, and has been one of the fastest growing listed European companies for almost three decades.

title: Expert Senior Manager, Process Excellence – Source to Pay (S2P)
description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH
  
  
You will join the Process Excellence team within Bain’s Applied Technology & AI practice. The team helps clients rethink how they operate, combining deep process expertise with SAP and AI to deliver measurable business results. You will be embedded in multidisciplinary teams with Bain consultants and other experts in architecture, technology delivery, data science, engineering and design, serving leading companies across industries in large SAP S/4HANA and AI-enabled transformations.
  
  
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  
  
Mission
  
  

* Lead end-to-end Source to Pay transformations, from spend analysis, sourcing and contracting to supplier management, purchasing, invoicing and payment.
* Redesign S2P processes with AI built in, deciding where AI agents, machine learning and automation should run a task, support a person or stay out, with the goal of simple, touchless and well-controlled processes.
* Act as business architect and trusted advisor in SAP- and AI-enabled programs, making sure technology choices serve business outcomes rather than drive them.
* Shape the value case, operating model, governance and controls of S2P transformations, from early diagnostic through implementation and scale-up.
* Deliver measurable impact across procurement and accounts payable: savings, spend under management, compliance, productivity, user experience and working capital.

Essential functions
  
  

* Lead current-state diagnostics, fact base development and future-state blueprinting across the S2P process: spend analytics, category and sourcing strategy for direct and indirect spend, contract management, supplier onboarding and management, requisition to order, goods and service receipt, and invoice to pay.
* Define target-state process design and key design principles, including where to standardize globally and where local, statutory or control requirements call for variation.
* Identify, size and prioritize AI use cases along the S2P process, such as spend classification, sourcing and negotiation assistants, contract analysis, supplier risk monitoring, supplier collaboration on direct materials forecasts and orders, guided buying and AI-based request intake, invoice capture and matching, and agents that resolve exceptions or answer supplier queries.
* Advise clients on how AI is changing what they expect from procurement and accounts payable, and turn it into end-to-end S2P process redesign rather than isolated use cases.
* Design how people and AI agents will work together, including roles, approval and decision rights, controls, audit trail, and the supplier, material and contract data that AI needs to work at scale.
* Identify gaps between business needs and the standard capabilities of SAP S/4HANA and leading S2P platforms, and recommend standardization versus customization trade-offs.
* Shape value cases, KPIs and benefits tracking, so that transformations and AI investments are anchored in measurable outcomes.
* Design target operating models for procurement and accounts payable, including shared services, centers of excellence and the split of responsibilities between global, regional and local teams.
* Drive integration with adjacent domains such as Finance (R2R), Plan to Fulfil (including direct materials planning, supplier scheduling and inbound), Master Data and Tax.
* Lead client workshops and decision-making sessions, challenging legacy ways of working and aligning stakeholders on leading-practice choices.
* Act as process design authority through implementation, including end-to-end test scenarios for system integration and user acceptance testing, keeping the system integrator, technical and AI teams aligned with the intended outcomes.
* Support proposal development and commercial shaping for major SAP, AI and procurement transformation programs.
* International travel is required up to 50% of working time.

ABOUT YOU
  
  
Education
  
  

* Required: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in business administration, economics, engineering, information technology, business informatics or related fields.
* Preferred: Additional training in procurement or supply management (for example CIPS), finance, analytics or AI.

Experience
  
  

* 10+ years of professional experience, including significant experience in S2P process transformation within large SAP-enabled programs, ideally SAP S/4HANA.
* Extensive experience in process design and transformation across procurement, accounts payable and shared services organizations.
* Deep expertise in indirect spend and the purchase-to-pay backbone; strong preference for hands-on experience in direct procurement (for example raw materials and packaging sourcing, contracting and supplier management) and how it connects with planning and manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience with AI or advanced automation in S2P processes within the last 1-2 years (for example shaping, designing, delivering or advising on a use case), with a clear view of the value delivered, the process changes it required and the lessons learned.
* Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement and leading S2P platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Jaggaer, GEP or equivalent, including their AI capabilities. Deep technical SAP architecture expertise is not required; the focus is functional process depth with a solid grasp of what the platforms can do.
* Able to describe what best-in-class S2P processes look like, what SAP S/4HANA and leading S2P platforms support as standard, and where companies typically customize.
* Proven success engaging senior stakeholders such as CPOs, CFOs and heads of shared services, and acting as a trusted advisor in complex transformations.
* Experience in one or more relevant industries such as consumer products, retail, industrials, life sciences or manufacturing.
* Fluency in English, written and spoken.

Knowledge, skills and abilities
  
  

* Deep end-to-end S2P expertise, connecting sourcing, contracts and supplier management with purchasing, receipt, invoicing and payment into one coherent process design.
* Ability to define and articulate the main value drivers in S2P transformations, such as savings and savings leakage, spend under management, contract compliance, maverick spend, touchless PO and invoice rates, cycle times, cost per invoice, payment accuracy, payment terms and working capital, direct material cost and supply continuity, and supplier risk.
* Solid understanding of AI and how to apply it in procurement and finance operations: the main types (generative AI, AI agents, machine learning, process mining and automation), what each does well, its limits and the data it needs.
* Working knowledge of SAP Business AI (including Joule), SAP Business Network and the AI roadmaps of leading S2P platforms, and how they fit with the SAP S/4HANA core.
* Good judgment on when AI is the right answer and when process simplification, standardization or classic automation is enough.
* Strong understanding of internal controls, compliance and audit requirements in S2P, and how they need to change when AI agents take over tasks.
* Ability to lead both executive-level discussions and detailed L3/L4 process conversations, adapting the level of detail to the audience and project phase.
* Ability to use spend data, process mining and performance metrics to find bottlenecks, quantify opportunities and track benefits.
* Familiarity with change management and adoption approaches for requesters, buyers and accounts payable teams, including building trust in AI-supported decisions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a hands-on ability to create clear, ready-to-use client materials.
* Leadership skills to guide and develop small teams of junior consultants or experts.

Nice to have
  
  

* Has built simple AI prototypes or agents, for example with low-code tools such as SAP Build or Microsoft Copilot Studio, or has basic Python or SQL skills.
* Experience with process mining tools such as SAP Signavio or Celonis in S2P.
* Experience with AI-native procurement or accounts payable automation tools, including autonomous negotiation for tail spend.
* Professional certifications, such as CIPS or SAP certifications in SAP Ariba or S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement.

MVF connects people who are ready to buy with the brands that want them as customers. Founded in London in 2009, with a US hub in Austin, we run 20+ marketing channels, 4m first-party data records and our own technology and AI to create demand, capture it and turn it into sales.  
  
Our clients sit in 200+ verticals, from enterprise names like Salesforce and Ford to fast-growing challengers, and the business generates more than £140m a year. We work as a full-funnel go-to-market partner: we build awareness, capture intent and lift conversion through customer-facing brands such as Expert Market.  
  
**Our Team**  
Every other marketing team at MVF markets our clients' brands. This team markets MVF itself, to the companies we want as clients, and it sits inside the sales organisation so that everything it does ends in a sales conversation.  
  
We're partway into a three-year sales and commercial transformation, aiming for net revenue retention of 100% and approx 6% of revenue from new logos. Over the next six months that includes a refreshed client value proposition, an MVF rebrand launching by March 2027, and account-based marketing into the 200 accounts we most want. You'll work closely with our sales teams in London and Austin, and with the brand and design team who own the MVF identity.

**What we're offering you:**

* Summer Fridays
* Competitive holiday benefits - 25 days a year paid holiday, plus 8 bank holidays (increases 1 day a year up to 30 days)
* Hybrid working - 3 days a week in the office
* Closed for Christmas holidays - Extra days not taken from your annual holiday allowance.
* Work from anywhere for 2 weeks a year
* Life Assurance and Income Protection to protect your loved ones
* Benefits allowance for health, dental, and vision coverage
* Six months paid maternity leave, and one month paid paternity leave (subject to qualifying conditions) inclusive of same-sex and adoptive parents
* Defined Contribution Pension and Salary Sacrifice Scheme
* Be Well: Our award-winning wellbeing and mental health programme to support all MVFers and their families
* Family Forward support for our MVF parents and their mini-mes
* 2 charity days a year

**The Role**  
  
Our addressable market is small enough to name company by company. Around 200 businesses make up the accounts we most want, and you'll own the plan that gets MVF known by, and in the room with, every one of them. You'll tier the list, build a marketing plan for each top account and each cluster, and run it across LinkedIn, events, podcasts, content and gifting alongside the salespeople who own those relationships.  
  
You'll be measured on first meetings, pipeline and return on spend. Every programme you run will have a meeting target, a budget and trial period so we scale what works quickly and stop what doesn't.  
  
There's no inherited team or playbook here. You'll set the function up from scratch, do most of the work yourself at the start, and add people once the numbers justify it. The role suits someone who wants to build something with their own hands, and has the know how to execute effectively  
  
**In short: get MVF in front of every account we want to win, and show the result in pipeline.**  
  
**Responsibilities**  
  
**The role has four areas of accountability.**  
  
**1. Build the plan for every account we want**

* Agree the target account list with sales leadership, mapped to our zones and hubs, and tier it
* Map the buying committee in every top-tier account, so we know who we're talking to, what they care about and what would get them to take a meeting.
* Write a marketing plan for each top-tier account and each cluster, agreed with the salesperson who owns it.
* Set up the data and tools the programme needs, including intent signals, LinkedIn account targeting and source tracking in Pipedrive, using what we already have before buying more.
* Own our agency relationship with our organic linkedin Agency and set out parameters for success and ways of working with them
* Create content suites and libraries for sales people for their outbound outreach  
    
  **2. Run the programmes**

* LinkedIn, organic and paid: grow MVF's and our leaders' presence with the people on the list, and run paid campaigns aimed at named accounts.
* Events and conferences: pick the industry events our target accounts attend in the UK and US, and get MVF on stage, on the stand and hosting the dinners around them. Run our own small, invite-only events for target accounts and our largest clients.
* Podcasts and content: get our leaders onto the podcasts and panels our buyers follow, and turn MVF's research, starting with our $1bn report, into content written for specific accounts and clusters.
* Gifting and direct mail: design personal gifting for target accounts and key clients, with a sales follow-up planned for every send.
* Online: own account-specific landing pages, retargeting and the outreach sequences sales use, working with our web and brand teams.
* Manage the agencies and partners we use, holding them to the same meeting and pipeline targets you're held to.  
    
  **3. Prove the return**

* Agree a meeting target, budget and kill date for every programme before it starts, then scale what works and stop what doesn't.
* Trace every first meeting to its source in Pipedrive, and report sourced and influenced pipeline separately so the numbers stand up with finance.
* Report monthly to the Group Sales Director on accounts engaged, first meetings, pipeline, win rate and cost per opportunity.
* Build the business case for any further investment needed  
    
  **4. Work as part of the sales team**

* Sit with the sales team, join account planning, and make sure every reply or hand-raise from a target account reaches the right salesperson the same day.
* Give sales the collateral, talk tracks and social content to pitch MVF as a full-funnel go-to-market partner once the new proposition and brand launch.
* Train salespeople in social selling and account-based selling

**Our ideal MVFer**

* 8+ years in B2B marketing, including at least 3 running account-based marketing into enterprise or mid-market accounts.
* Has built an ABM or field marketing function from scratch, and can show the meetings, pipeline and revenue it produced.
* Has done the work personally: written the campaigns, run the LinkedIn ads, booked the stands and briefed the agencies. May have led a sizeable team, and is happy to work without one while the function proves itself.
* Hands-on experience across organic and paid LinkedIn, events and conferences, podcasts and thought leadership, client gifting and online campaigns.
* Has marketed to marketing and sales leaders, ideally from a marketing services, media, lead generation or B2B software business.
* Measures success in meetings and pipeline, is fluent in a CRM such as Pipedrive, HubSpot or Salesforce, and understands the difference between sourced and influenced pipeline.
* Enjoys working with salespeople, wants a seat in account planning, and is comfortable being held to a number.
* A self-starter who writes well, spends a budget as if it were their own, and makes calls without waiting to be told.
* Comfortable working across London and Austin time zones, and travelling to events in the UK and US.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**  
*Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are the foundation for MVF to build, promote and sustain a culture of trust, safety, growth and belonging where everyone can thrive. Our DEI guiding principles underpin how we build our teams, develop our talent, provide a fair working environment and create an ambitious company that reflects the diversity of our employees, customers, clients and partners, globally.*  
  
*As an equal opportunities employer, we encourage all MVFers to respect, value and celebrate our differences, and commit to actions that ensure that we can belong and be authentic at MVF, without limitations or barriers.*  
  
*We’re committed to providing support and/or adjustments to those who may need them during employment. If you consider yourself someone who may need support or adjustments, please speak with your Line Manager, Department DEI Ambassador or People Partner.*  
  
*We are diverse by nature, but inclusive by choice.*

title: Senior Manager, CX Messaging and Activation Lead
description:
At Pfizer, our purpose is breakthroughs that change patients' lives. As we implement our AI Transformation, our GTM and Adoption team helps turn digital investment into real impact by understanding and removing barriers, driving high-impact engagement, and ensuring the new digital platforms we launch become embedded into how our colleagues work.
  
  
This is a product marketing role. The products are internal AI platforms. The market is roughly 80,000 Pfizer colleagues around the world. Positioning, segmentation, launch, and demand generation all apply here, with adoption and retention as the scoreboard.
  
  
The craft at the center of the role is positioning: holding one argument per platform and telling it in many ways. A scientist in the lab, a supervisor on a manufacturing line, and an analyst in finance should each recognize their own work in the same value proposition, and a colleague who has never heard of a platform needs something different from one who tried it once and stopped. Working norms, language, and attitudes toward AI at work also differ across our markets and business lines, so messaging here is adapted for the audience rather than translated once and sent everywhere. What we are claiming stays constant. How it is told, to whom, and at what point in their journey is where this role does its work.
  
  
This role translates technical features into highly compelling, user-centric narratives, running internal product launches with the same rigor, creativity, and brand building typically reserved for external consumer technology launches. Most internal launch emails and mandatory announcements get ignored, and that's the bar this role is here to clear: before defaulting to the standard internal-comms playbook, this role tries something unconventional first, and builds campaigns around what actually earns attention rather than what's easiest to schedule.
  
  
**Positioning, Messaging & Segmentation**

* Segment by lifecycle stage rather than by org chart. Match messaging to where a colleague sits with a platform: one who has never heard of it needs a reason to care, one who tried it once and stopped needs a different reason to come back, and one who uses it weekly needs to know what changed.
* Build divisional and cultural understanding into the work. Language, regulatory context, working norms, and attitudes toward AI at work differ across markets and business lines, and a message that reads as exciting in one place can read as overselling or as a threat in another. Partner with divisional and local communicators so messaging is adapted rather than translated.
* Ground the WIIFM ("What’s In It For Me") in the colleague’s actual workday: the task that gets shorter, the handoff that stops breaking, the report nobody has to rebuild by hand. Avoid capability claims that do not name a job somebody is trying to get done.
* Own the competitive frame. Position each platform against what colleagues are choosing instead, whether an external consumer AI tool, a manual workaround, or doing nothing, and make the honest case for the internal option rather than assuming the audience is captive.
* Test messaging with real colleagues before it ships, in more than one division, and rewrite what does not land.
* Keep the message library current as platforms change, and retire claims that stop being true.

**Go-to-Market & Launch**

* Set the channel and audience strategy for each launch, deciding which channels to use and who to target, and own the resulting content end to end, creative through send.
* Coordinate channel and audience decisions with the Peer Advocacy & Community Lead so broadcast and community messaging reinforce each other rather than duplicate or conflict.
* Write the go-to-market plan for every major launch: target audience, messaging pillars in play, channel mix, sequencing, asset list, dates, and the adoption number the launch is meant to move. A launch is a plan on paper before it is a calendar invite.
* Run the pre-launch phase. Early access cohorts, waitlists, teasers, and champion previews build demand ahead of general availability so day one has an audience waiting rather than an audience being informed.
* Sequence the launch with the CX Training Lead and the Peer Advocacy & Community Lead so messaging, training readiness, and community activity land in the right order rather than competing on the same day.
* Run a post-launch review after every Major launch: what the campaign moved, what it did not, and what changes in the next one. Feed the pattern back into the reusable launch approach.

**Demand Generation & Funnel Ownership**

* Own the top of the funnel end to end, from unaware through interested to first use. Know the drop-off at each step, and fix the weakest step rather than adding more volume at the top.
* Build the always-on layer that runs between launches so demand does not depend on a campaign being live: placement on the surfaces colleagues already hit, internal search and intranet presence, the platform site, and the moments new joiners are most open to trying something.

**Enablement, Standards & Message Governance**

* Establish the reusable launch playbook: message standards, frameworks, and templates that later launches and other teams run on.
* Enable the people who carry the message. Equip stakeholders, champions, and divisional communicators with the positioning, proof points, and assets to make the case in their own words. This is sales enablement without a sales team.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing through communication channels that connect colleagues with successful practices, lessons learned, and success stories.
* Prepare colleagues for change by developing communication strategies that support adoption of new tools, workflows, and behaviors.

**Platform & Strategy Partnership**

* Partner closely with the Experience Architecture and Product teams to understand what each platform is and the CX strategy defined for it, so positioning and messaging stay grounded in the platform’s actual intent.
* Feed user insights, friction points, and feature requests surfaced through campaigns and interviews back to the teams building and evolving each platform.

**Ethical Use & Responsible AI Messaging**

* Define clear, plain-language guidance on the ethical and responsible use of each AI platform, appropriate use cases, data handling, and when to trust versus verify AI output, as part of launch and ongoing messaging.
* Shape that guidance in partnership with Legal, Compliance, and Regulatory Affairs so it stays accurate and consistent as platforms evolve.
* Share ethical-use guidance directly with the CX Training Lead so it gets built into training content, and with the Peer Advocacy & Community Lead so it is reinforced through the champion network and community norms.

**Legal & Regulatory Alignment**

* Own the legal, compliance, and regulatory review checkpoint for platform messaging, built into the launch timeline as a fast, repeatable step rather than a one-off cycle, so nothing overstates a platform’s capabilities, data handling, or compliance posture.
* Know which platforms touch regulated, clinical, or personal data, and keep messaging current with internal policy on AI-related communications.

**Producing the Work, Not Just Briefing It**

* Write, design, and produce the core campaign assets, launch copy, short-form video, key visuals, on a real production cadence.
* This is not a brief-an-agency-and-wait role; the person hired is expected to make the work themselves or partner internally with the design teams, especially in the early days of a launch when speed matters most.

**Campaign Metrics Tied to Real Adoption**

* Set quarterly targets for campaign metrics (click-throughs, video views, waitlist sign-ups), but treat none of them as the finish line.
* Ensure every campaign metric ladders up to the platform’s two core success metrics, 30-day active use and the Sean Ellis test.
* Partner with the Adoption Analytics & Insights Lead on the dashboard that shows that connection, not just the vanity numbers.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field.
* 6–8+ years in product marketing, digital marketing, or brand strategy, with a highly creative portfolio. Product marketing for a software, SaaS, or platform product is the closest fit, whether the audience was external customers or internal users.
* Experience owning top-of-funnel performance, including awareness-to-first-use conversion and diagnosing where an audience drops off.
* Experience owning a product launch end to end, including go-to-market planning, launch tiering, pre-launch demand building, and post-launch review.
* Experience building a messaging architecture (pillars, proof points, persona-level messaging) for a product or platform and holding other teams to it.
* Experience establishing messaging standards, launch frameworks, or reusable practices that other teams, platforms, or business units adopt.
* Experience translating complex technical or AI capabilities into clear, persona-specific business benefits and messaging.
* Hands-on experience personally writing, designing, and producing campaign assets on areal production cadence, not only briefing and reviewing agency or vendor work.
* Experience defining launch tiers and orchestrating cross-functional launch timelines and communications.
* Daily, hands-on use of AI tools in your own production work, with a clear view of where they help and where they fall short.
* Experience partnering with Legal, Compliance, or Regulatory teams to review communications before publication, ideally within a pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated industry.
* Comfort tying campaign metrics (engagement, click-through, sign-ups) to downstream adoption and retention outcomes rather than treating them as the end goal.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in consumer tech, B2B SaaS, a creative agency, or another fast-paced digital marketing environment.
* Experience launching or positioning an AI product, or explaining AI capability and limitation to a non-technical audience.
* Proficiency with modern creative design and video editing tools.
* Experience driving engagement within enterprise collaboration tools (e.g., Teams, Slack, Viva Engage).
* Experience partnering with architecture, engineering, or technical teams to ground messaging in actual platform capability and strategy.
* Familiarity with pharmaceutical or healthcare industry communication standards (e.g., promotional review processes, data privacy requirements) as they apply to internal, employee-facing content.
* Experience partnering with learning and community counterparts to sequence messaging, training, and community activity into a single integrated launch plan.
* Experience preparing stakeholder groups for a change in how they work through audience-specific messaging.
* Experience developing or communicating responsible or ethical AI use guidance for an internal or external audience.
* Experience positioning a product against a free or already-preferred alternative and winning users back.
* Experience running message testing, user research, or win-loss style interviews to shape positioning before launch.

description:
**About Ramp**
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
  
  
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
  
  
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
  
  
The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
  
  
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.
  
  
**About The Role**
Design at Ramp looks very different than it did a year ago: we’re building tools and agents, designing memory, shipping PRs, and rethinking the process every few months as new capabilities unlock. A few things have not changed, the role of design is to distill problems to their essence, obsess over craft and delight where it matters most, know customers deeply and advocate for them, lead with creativity and storytelling, and keep it fun, because a product built with joy always wins.
  
  
We're looking for a Director of Product Design to lead a team of builders across some of our highest-priority bets. This role is for you if you’re excited by:
  
  

* Leading through craft, setting vision and unlocking customer impact: you will define where a product should go, then jump into the details with the team to unblock, teach, and ship. You raise the bar through product judgment, design craft, and your ability to make everyone around you better.
* Actually shipping and demonstrating real impact: You'll start by owning a product area and team to build trust and get your bearings at Ramp, with room to take on broader leadership over time. You'll stay close to customers and ship meaningful work alongside your designers, product managers and engineers.
* Building the environment where great work comes from: clear roles, high standards, low ego, and just enough structure to keep the bar high without slowing people down. That means building a caring yet demanding structure, investing deeply in people — coaching, feedback, growth — so designers can do the best work of their careers and develop in this new age of Design.

It’s never been a more interesting time to build.
  
  
***Please note that this role will require you to be comfortable with working in-person at our NYC HQ (located near Madison Square Park) at least 3 days/week.***
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Lead and grow a high-performing team of product designers
* Own product vision and design direction across critical product areas
* Partner with product and engineering to shape strategy and deliver customer impact
* Stay close to customers and use their feedback to guide product decisions
* Jump into the work when needed to unblock teams and accelerate progress
* Create clarity, raise quality, and help teams ship faster
* Raise the bar for product thinking, interaction design, systems thinking, and craft
* Coach designers through clear feedback, high standards, and strong mentorship
* Help define how design works in an AI-native world
* Build strong partnerships across product, engineering, data, and design

What You Need
  
  

* Experience leading and developing high-performing product design teams
* Strong product judgment, design craft, and systems thinking
* Track record of shipping products with meaningful customer and business impact
* Deep customer empathy and comfort operating in ambiguity
* Ability to influence across functions and develop exceptional talent
* Curiosity that borders obsession over how AI changes the nature software and how we work

Nice to Haves
  
  

* Founder or early-stage startup experience
* Experience designing AI-native, automation, or agentic systems
* Experience building workflow or operations tooling
* Experience leading managers or multi-layered teams
* Comfort working closely with technical teams on implementation details

description:

The Design Director will lead all design and development processes across the division. Reporting into the President, this role oversees a team of designers to produce new products that reflect brand strategy, market trends, and meet customer needs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Articulate a clear and passionate point of view for the category
* Create quarterly seasonal concepts
* Regularly shop competitors to keep abreast of trends. Travel Europe/Asia to identify emerging themes and new inspirations
* Oversee design and development of assigned categories from concept to completion.
* Ensure that design team successfully translates seasonal direction into viable product.
* Present and sell seasonal design direction to merchandising team and executives, identify key business driving ideas and items.
* Identify big business ideas to be developed and ensure Designers have clear understanding of the product line.
* Ensure that all final design details and pre-production samples are approved by Designers (with Product Development). Resolve escalated issues.
* Drive innovation in the category with regards to color, pattern, and construction.
* Achieve operational excellence in product development:

+ Partner with merchants to ensure needs/briefs are clear, meaningful, and support seasonal big ideas.
+ Manage product development to the brand calendar and achieve key milestone dates.
+ Utilize multiple internal and external data sources to inform the early stages of our design brief and product development process.

**Criteria**

* Proven track record of a strong ability to conceptualize design across multiple product categories
* Minimum 7-10 years product design experience.

title: Director of AI Experience Design
description:
**About OpenLoop**
------------------

OpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.

We are the digital health infrastructure powering modern medicine. Healthcare and non-healthcare brands use our white-label platform to launch, scale and run virtual and hybrid care without the operational complexity. We bring together one of the largest telehealth clinician networks in the country, nationwide payer coverage, integrated pharmacy and lab partners, EHR connectivity, 24/7 patient support and full revenue cycle management. Our partners put their brand on the front end, and everything behind it runs on us. We serve more than 3 million patients a year and power over 1 million visits a month.

**About the Role**
------------------

As **Director of AI Experience Design** at OpenLoop Health, you'll lead design across everything we build: patient and client-facing experiences, our White-Label platform and Launchpad, AI agents and copilots, and the operational platforms our teams use every day.

You'll set a multi-year design vision, grow and lead the team, and own the system our products are built on. That system won't only guide human designers. It becomes the contract AI follows, precise enough that AI tools can build UI that meets our bar. You'll also help designers, engineers, and PMs use AI effectively and at scale, so the team can do more without lowering the bar on quality.

You'll treat design like a business: own the outcomes, make focused bets, and iterate based on customer truth and data. This is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of strategy and execution.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Set the design vision and strategy across patient, client, and internal products, and turn bold ideas into outcomes patients, clients, and the business can measure.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of designers. Establish clear career paths, strong critique, and a culture with a high bar for craft.
* Own the design system as the source of truth, not a side artifact. That covers tokens, components, information hierarchy, and interaction principles, with theming across the many client brands our White-Label platform supports.
* Make the system AI-ready. Ship standards as code (tokens, patterns, and components wired into the engineering pipeline) so the correct, accessible, compliant pattern is the default for people and AI coding agents alike.
* Measure the system like a product, using adoption in code, pattern reuse, override rates, and first-pass quality, and retire patterns the data shows are failing.
* Help the Product & Tech org use AI effectively and at scale, with the workflows, tools, and standards that let the team ship more without sacrificing quality.
* Set the standard for how AI shows up in our products, across voice, chat, and autonomous agents. That covers trust patterns like transparency, citations, confidence, error recovery, escalation, and human handoff in a regulated healthcare setting.
* Ground decisions in research. Run discovery and usability testing with patients, clinicians, and clients, and prototype in code with real data to validate ideas before they scale.
* Audit existing and acquired surfaces, such as Hey Revia and Season Health, and drive convergence toward a single coherent experience.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leaders on problem definition, roadmap, and scoping.
* Own design KPIs and instrument the experience to quantify impact. Represent Design in executive forums with clear narratives, tradeoffs, and results.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 10+ years in product design, with 3+ years leading teams directly. B2B or B2B2C SaaS experience preferred.
* A portfolio showing end-to-end systems thinking, exceptional craft, and shipped work at scale across web and mobile.
* A track record of designing and shipping AI-powered or agentic experiences in production, and of changing how teams and AI tools actually build.
* Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain great design talent.
* Inspired by products where systematic design creates clarity, and you know what separates great product experiences from good ones.
* Meticulous and opinionated, able to hold the line on standards while moving fast.
* Comfortable being both hands-on (Figma, tokens, specs, prototyping in code with tools like Claude Code) and strategic (principles, governance, cross-team alignment).
* A strong command of accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and of designing for trust in high-stakes settings.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, able to align executives around crisp narratives and metrics.
* Healthcare or other regulated-industry experience is a plus.

**Our Benefits**
----------------

In addition, for salaried positions you would also be eligible for:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
* Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts
* Flexible PTO
* 401(k) + Company Match
* Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more

**Our Company**
---------------

We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work.

Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

description:

Set up and manage redundant account architecture (backup BMs, ad accounts, payment methods) to guarantee zero downtime and keep spend scaling uninterrupted.
