At AtlasBrands, we value your time and expertise, which is why we’ve built a streamlined, highly transparent interview process designed to look for a true partner rather than a transactional contributor.

title: Head of Growth
description:
**About Zable**
Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to
**build**
the
**world's best technology**
to
**help people get credit**
and
**save money**
.
  
  

* Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021
* The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK
* Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan
* Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.
  
  
The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.
  
  
Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.
  
  
**Join us if you want to**

* Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one
* Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo
* Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

**Growth Lead**
We’re looking for a senior Growth Lead with deep expertise in brand and trade marketing to shape how Mexican consumers see our brand and to build our in-store acquisition channel. Your mission is not just to grow volume, but to grow the right customers: attracting higher-quality, lower-risk and more profitable cardholders for our Mexico Credit Card.
  
  
A big part of the opportunity is a channel few card issuers in Mexico are present in: in-store acquisition through our merchant partners. Physical retailers already distribute our cards at the point of sale, and the channel is largely untapped. We want someone who can turn it into a growth engine through trade marketing, in-store promotions, POP and co-marketing with our merchants.
  
  
You’ll also own our brand in Mexico: positioning, messaging and creative direction across socials, digital and in-store. You’ll work closely with our UK growth and analytics team, who lead performance marketing, tracking and attribution, and with our Credit team to make sure every campaign brings in customers who are good for the business.
  
  
This role is central to scaling our Mexico Credit Card, a mobile-app–first product designed for credit builders in Mexico.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build Trade & Retail Marketing at the Point of Sale
* Own the growth strategy for our in-store acquisition channel with physical merchant partners.
* Build and run a trade marketing calendar with each merchant: promotions such as a free card with the purchase of selected products or above a spend threshold, in-store activations and brand ambassadors.
* Develop POP and in-store advertising, from concept to production and rollout across store networks, that drives awareness and sign-ups at the shelf and at checkout.
* Launch co-marketing campaigns with merchants through their own channels (apps, loyalty programs, catalogues, socials) and joint offers.
* Work with merchant partners, Operations and Engineering on execution: store staff incentives and training, systems integration and reconciliation of promotion costs.
* Build a repeatable playbook so we can launch new merchant partners quickly.
* Own & Build Our Brand in Mexico
* Own brand positioning, messaging and identity, shaping how Mexican consumers perceive us so we attract the customers we want to serve.
* Define creative direction and lead brand campaigns across socials, digital, out-of-home and in-store.
* Build a creative engine (in-house, agencies, creators) that produces high-quality assets at speed.
* Grow our organic social presence, content and community.
* Track brand health (awareness, consideration, perception) and connect brand work to acquisition results.
* Connect Brand, Retail & Digital
* Design digital-to-store campaigns with merchants that drive customers into stores to get their card (e.g. geo-targeted social, merchant channels).
* Keep the brand consistent across every touchpoint, and provide messaging and creative for our performance campaigns.
* Partner with the UK growth and analytics team, who own performance marketing execution, tracking and attribution, so brand and trade campaigns are properly measured and learnings flow both ways.
* Measure What Matters
* Own the brand and trade marketing budget, and the return on it.
* Define clear KPIs for every campaign and merchant: cost per account, approval and activation rates, and customer quality.
* Work with Credit and the UK analytics team to understand which campaigns, merchants and promotions bring in profitable customers, and how CAC compares to LTV.
* Use results to reallocate spend across merchants, promotions and campaigns.

**Required Experience**
**What We’re Looking For**

* 6+ years in brand, trade, retail or shopper marketing, with senior ownership of meaningful budgets and targets, ideally at consumer brands, retailers or financial services in Mexico.
* A proven track record of launching trade marketing and in-store campaigns with retailers: promotions, POP, activations and co-marketing.
* Experience building or repositioning a consumer brand: positioning, messaging, creative direction and campaigns.
* Strong experience working with and negotiating with Mexican retailers and their store teams.
* Experience managing creative, BTL and production agencies and vendors.
* Commercially minded and data-literate: comfortable setting KPIs, reading campaign results and tying spend to outcomes.
* Strong execution across many stakeholders (merchants, Operations, Finance, Credit).
* Proficiency in English and Spanish (you’ll work closely with our UK team).
* Deep understanding of Mexican consumers.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience in performance marketing across Meta, Google, TikTok or app marketing.
* Familiarity with tracking and data integrations, such as Meta Conversions API (CAPI), Google offline conversions, MMPs and attribution.
* Analytical skills such as SQL, cohort analysis or unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback).
* Experience in credit cards, lending or other financial services, ideally with an understanding of credit risk.
* Previous start-up or scale-up experience, ideally building a channel from zero.
* Experience leading a team.

**The Type of Work You’ll Be Doing**

* Plan and launch trade marketing promotions with merchant partners.
* Create POP and in-store materials, and roll them out across store networks.
* Negotiate co-marketing plans with merchants and onboard new partners.
* Define our brand positioning and lead brand campaigns.
* Brief and manage creative work, agencies and creators.
* Design digital-to-store campaigns with merchants.
* Review campaign and merchant performance with Credit and the UK analytics team, and reallocate budget.
* Report on growth performance to leadership and keep the team focused on what moves the needle.
* Help hire and build out the growth team as we scale.

**How You’ll Contribute To Zable**

* Ownership: You own brand and in-store acquisition end to end, from strategy and budget to results.
* Brand Building: You create a brand that Mexican consumers trust and want to be part of.
* Retail Savvy: You know how to win at the point of sale and how to work with retailers.
* Quality Over Volume: You optimize for good, profitable customers, not vanity metrics.
* Data-Informed: You measure everything and let results guide where spend goes.
* Creativity: You find new ways to reach customers, in store and online.
* Prioritization: You focus ruthlessly on high-impact bets.
* Speed: You thrive in an environment where shipping fast and iterating is the norm.
* Collaboration: You work smoothly with merchants, agencies, Credit and our UK team.

**Interview Process**

* CV Screening

* Hiring Manager Call

**Location**

**Compensation**

* $150,000 - $200,000 Mexican pesos, per month, before taxes

**Life at Zable**

* The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

* **Socials & connection:**

description:

title: Director of Energy Storage Modeling and Design
description:
### **ROLE OVERVIEW**

Pivot Energy is seeking a motivated individual to join our Technical Operations team and lead the company’s Energy Storage modeling and design. The role covers market analysis, technical vendor evaluation, pricing, modeling, sizing, and design recommendations for our storage (DC-coupled with PV solar and standalone storage) project pipeline. This role combines aspects of engineering, collaboration with finance, operations, and policy teams with a goal of deploying and optimizing our storage pipeline.

The Director will be responsible for technical analysis of all solar- plus-storage (DC-coupled) and standalone energy storage market opportunities, including optimal system sizing. The Director will work with the market strategy, policy, and finance teams on revenue modeling and financial analysis, and with Estimation, Procurement, and Commercial Operations to optimize CAPEX and OPEX. The role also works regularly with project development leads and cross-team leads in Project Development Origination, Grid Interconnection, Engineering, Finance, Delivery, O&M, and Asset Management.The Director will have the opportunity to identify and vet potential areas of new energy storage business development, such as new geographies, programs, incentives, or procurements.

This is an opportunity to join a small team in a fast-growing market at an exciting and expanding company. This position offers significant growth potential at a B Corporation with operations across the USA.

### **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop and maintain MATLAB and Excel based revenue projections for solar plus storage and standalone storage projects by maintaining and / or creating new custom tools or using third-party applications
* Use internal Excel-based financial models, determine the cost and overall value of distribution-scale solar plus storage, and standalone storage projects
* Train internal personnel use energy modeling tools (MATLAB or third-party) with a goal of scaling Pivot’s ability to model storage projects and markets.
* Train, teach, guide, and collaborate with external personnel that will review our energy models, inputs, assumptions, equations, and code.
* Work with other Pivot teams on detailed modeling and design and on external quoting of storge model inputs including CAPEX and OPEX
* Support internal opportunity leads from the Commercial team to define project value and pricing terms to developer partners and for utility RFPs through market and project level modeling and design assumptions
* Work with key hardware and software vendors on technical evaluation, pipeline discussions, modeling assumptions, design, pricing, and equipment specifications to optimize project-level design
* Provide design direction including sizing and equipment selection to the Engineering team for project-level design and interconnection applications.
* Support the Market Strategy team in vetting potential new markets through quantitative analysis of sample projects
* Advance individual and team BESS knowledge through structured training, self-directed learning, and educational opportunities across Pivot.
* Build, manage and guide a small team of BESS experts consisting of engineering, analytics, modeling, and other expertise necessary to guide sound market and project decisions related to BESS.
* Support team members’ career growth by helping them think through the market drivers affecting BESS.
* Regularly document and share key insights from energy storage analysis process with relevant internal teams
* Track opportunities and analysis requests in Pivot’s CRM tools

### **REQUIRED COMPETENCIES**

title: Sr. Director, Sourcing & Procurement – General Contractors, Design Consultants, Substation EPC & Commissioning
description:
**Job Type:** Full-time **| Location:** San Francisco **| Department:** Procurement **| Reporting to:** VP, Data Center Procurement **|****Work Location Type:** #hybrid

The Senior Director, Sourcing & Procurement will own the end-to-end sourcing, contracting, and commercial
  
management strategy for General Contractor (GC), Architecture/Engineering (AE) design consultant, Substation EPC, and Commissioning (Cx) agent services supporting the company's U.S. hyperscale and AI-infrastructure data center construction program. This role is the primary procurement authority across the pre-construction, GC selection, sub trade selection, substation EPC, and commissioning phases of new-build and expansion projects, partnering closely with Construction, Engineering, Development, Legal, and Finance to secure capacity, control cost and schedule risk, and drive consistent, defensible contracting outcomes across a fast-growing portfolio of data center campuses.

  
  

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

  

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

  

Sourcing & Contracting Strategy

* Develop and execute global sourcing strategy for General Contractor, sub trades, Design-Build, and CMAR partners across shell/core, fit-out, and EPC substation scopes for U.S. data center builds.
* Lead procurement of AE/design consultant services (civil, structural, MEP, electrical distribution, low-voltage) and third-party Commissioning (Cx) agents across all project phases (Cx, IST, and turnover).
* Structure and negotiate contracts under GMP, lump sum, CMAR, Design-Build, and Progressive Design-Build models, tailoring commercial structure to project risk profile, schedule urgency, and market capacity.
* Build and maintain a qualified bench of regional and national GC, MEP, AE, and Cx partners to secure capacity ahead of an aggressive, multi-site construction pipeline.

Substation EPC

* Lead sourcing and contracting of Substation EPC scope (utility-interconnect and on-site substations), including transformers, switchgear, protection and controls, and interconnection-related civil/electrical works.
* Coordinate substation EPC procurement timelines with utility interconnection studies, HV transformer lead times, and GC construction sequencing to protect energization milestones.
* Negotiate substation EPC contracts and manage EPC contractor performance across design, procurement, and construction phases, including interface management with the GC and utility.

Cost, Risk & Schedule Management

* Own construction cost negotiations and benchmarking across GC/EPC scopes, including GMP validation, change order governance, and open-book cost reconciliation.
* Partner with Legal and Risk on contract terms covering liquidated damages, bonding/insurance, indemnification, OFCI/CFCI/ODCI scope delineation, and warranty obligations.
* Monitor project schedules jointly with Construction Management to identify sourcing risk (labor, equipment, long-lead materials) and proactively mitigate GC/Cx-driven schedule slippage.
* Track and report portfolio-level spend, savings, and contract compliance to procurement and executive leadership.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Serve as the primary procurement business partner to Construction, Engineering, and Development leadership from site selection through project turnover.
* Represent Procurement in GC/AE/Cx/Substation EPC bid evaluations, contract award recommendations, and executive steering committee reviews.
* Build and mentor a team of category managers and buyers supporting the GC, design consultant, substation EPC, and commissioning categories as the portfolio scales.
* Establish standardized RFP templates, evaluation scorecards, and contract playbooks to drive consistency and speed across a growing project portfolio.

  

* 10+ years of progressive procurement, construction management, or supply chain leadership experience in hyperscale or mission-critical data center construction; prior experience at a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or major GC/EPC firm strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated command of GC/EPC sourcing, AE/design consultant procurement, Substation EPC contracting, and third-party commissioning agent engagement for large-scale data center or industrial facility builds. Deep working knowledge of GMP, lump sum, CMAR, Design-Build, and Progressive Design-Build contracting models, and of OFCI/CFCI/ODCI scope structuring.
* Strong grounding in construction cost negotiations, project scheduling interdependencies, and Substation EPC and shell/core/fit-out delivery.
* Proven track record negotiating complex, high-value construction and professional services contracts, with sound judgment on risk allocation and commercial structuring.
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.
* Willingness and ability to travel to active construction sites across the U.S. as needed

title: Director of Brand Design
description:
**About Cardiff**

Cardiff lends to small businesses. Since 2004 we've funded more than $12 billion across the country, to businesses in logistics, healthcare, construction, professional services, and plenty in between. We're building our own underwriting technology, and we still answer the phone; our customers need capital fast, and they want a straight answer from a person who can actually help.

**Location:** San Diego, CA or Remote (U.S.)

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Department:** Product and Design/Marketing

**Reports to:** CMO

**Why This Role Matters**

Our customers are small business owners who need capital quickly and clearly. Every screen, form, and message they see shapes whether they trust us enough to apply, finish, and come back. As Director of Brand Design, you'll set the standard for how Cardiff looks, feels, and works across our product, our brand, and every customer touchpoint, and you'll build the team and design system that keep that standard high as we grow.

**What You'll Own**

  

* Set the design vision and strategy for Cardiff's customer-facing products, internal tools, and brand, in partnership with Engineering, Marketing, and leadership
* Lead end-to-end product design for the borrower journey, from first visit and application through underwriting, funding, and repeat borrowing
* Design internal tools for our underwriting, funding, sales, and servicing teams so they can move faster with fewer errors
* Build and maintain a scalable design system in Figma, with documented components, patterns, and accessibility standards that engineering can ship from directly
* Own brand and visual identity across web, paid media, email, direct mail, and sales materials, partnering closely with Marketing on campaign creative
* Ground design decisions in evidence through customer research, usability testing, funnel analytics, and split testing, with clear metrics tied to conversion and customer experience
* Ensure designs meet accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and the disclosure and compliance requirements of a regulated lending business
* Hire, lead, and develop the design team, running a predictable cadence of critique, delivery, and accountability
* Use AI tools throughout the design process, from research synthesis to prototyping, and help the team do the same

**What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 8+ years of product design experience, with at least 3 years leading designers and owning design outcomes for a digital product at a growth-stage company. Experience in fintech, lending, or financial services is a strong plus.
* **Product Design Craft:** A portfolio that shows strong interaction design, visual design, and information architecture on complex, multi-step flows such as applications, onboarding, or dashboards.
* **Design Systems:** Hands-on experience building and scaling a design system, and working closely with engineers to implement it in code.
* **Tools:** Expert-level Figma skills, fluency with prototyping and AI-assisted design tools, and a working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and how front-end code gets built.
* **Research and Data:** Comfort running user research and usability tests, and reading product analytics to find friction and measure the impact of design changes.
* **Leadership Style:** Hands-on, execution-focused leader with strong cross-functional communication skills; able to give clear feedback, make decisions with incomplete information, and explain design choices to non-designers. **Must have experience managing at least 4 direct reports.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Industry Perspective:** Experience designing for small business owners, B2B customers, or regulated, high-trust products such as lending, payments, or banking.
* **Conversion Design:** A track record of improving funnel conversion, application completion, or activation through measured design changes.
* **Brand Leadership:** Experience leading a brand refresh or building a visual identity system that works across product and marketing channels.
* **Content Design:** Skill at writing and shaping clear product copy, especially for financial terms, disclosures, and error states.
* **Organizational Scale:** Experience building a design function at an early or growth-stage company, including hiring, career leveling, and managing freelance and agency partners.

**This Role May Not Be a Fit If You**

* Want a strategy or advisory seat rather than hands-on ownership of the work that ships
* Have been out of the tools long enough that you'd need someone else to build the file or the prototype
* Prefer structured corporate environments with clear lanes and layers between you and the business
* Solve problems offline and come back with polished results, instead of sharing work early and communicating while you work
* Use AI tools to assist your old workflow, rather than having rebuilt your workflow around them

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Base salary range: $195,000+
* Performance bonus of up to 20% of base, tied to delivery and business outcomes
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Flexible PTO and observed holidays
* Remote-first, with support for your home-office setup
* Direct access to leadership and to the problems that matter

Cardiff, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Director of Brand Media
description:
**Director of Brand Media**

**About MVR**

MVR Digital is a performance marketing agency helping emerging brands grow profitably. We bring together paid media, creative, and measurement to help clients make better marketing decisions and turn investment into business growth.

**About This Role**

As Director of Brand Media, you will lead brand media strategy across MVR’s client portfolio. You’ll help clients determine where to invest across linear TV, connected TV, out-of-home, audio, and digital channels, and how to evaluate those investments.

You’ll connect brand objectives with audience insights, creative direction, and media planning. Working alongside our Head of Paid Media and channel specialists, you’ll build plans that connect awareness and consideration to customer acquisition and revenue.

You will own the strategic recommendation: which audiences to reach, which channels to use, how much to invest, and what we should learn before expanding.

**Brand Media Strategy and Planning**

* Develop integrated media strategies across linear TV, CTV and streaming, OOH and digital billboards, online video, audio, programmatic display, and other relevant channels.Translate client business goals into audience priorities, channel recommendations, geographic plans, budgets, and campaign timing.
* Determine when a client is ready to expand into brand media, considering budget, creative, measurement readiness, and growth opportunities.
* Evaluate reach, frequency, audience overlap, and channel costs to recommend an effective media mix.
* Partner with creative teams to shape briefs, messages, and formats that fit the audience and placement.
* Identify and evaluate new media opportunities, sponsorships, and partnerships.

  

**Investment and Partner Management**

* Own brand media budget recommendations and allocation across channels and markets.
* Build investment scenarios that explain tradeoffs, expected outcomes, and the evidence behind each recommendation.
* Select and manage buying partners, publishers, and specialist agencies. Lead negotiations around pricing, inventory, placement quality, and added value.
* Oversee delivery with internal teams and external partners, addressing pacing, quality, and performance issues.
* Recommend when to scale, adjust, or stop an investment.

  

**Measurement and Business Impact**

* Define campaign objectives, KPIs, and measurement plans before launch.
* Partner with analytics specialists and measurement providers on brand-lift studies, incrementality tests, and marketing mix modeling.
* Use Northbeam or comparable tools alongside sales, CRM, and campaign data to understand how brand activity contributes to downstream results.  
  Interpret MMM findings and translate them into channel and budget decisions.
* Evaluate changes in brand awareness, consideration, branded search, qualified traffic, acquisition, and revenue without assuming that correlation proves impact.
* Explain what is working, what remains uncertain, and what the team should test next.

  

**Client Leadership and Collaboration**

* Serve as MVR’s senior brand media advisor in client planning sessions, presentations, and business reviews.
* Bring proactive recommendations grounded in each client’s economics, customer behavior, and growth priorities.
* Partner with the Head of Paid Media to coordinate brand investment with paid search, paid social, and other performance channels.
* Work with creative, client success, and project management to align briefs, launches, and reporting.
* Support new business pitches and help define MVR’s brand media offering.
* Mentor team members and develop repeatable planning standards. Keep decisions, owners, and deliverables documented in ClickUp.

  

**What You Bring**

* Eight or more years of experience in media strategy, planning, or investment, including senior responsibility for client or brand strategy.
* Experience leading integrated campaigns across traditional and digital media, including TV, CTV, and OOH.
* A track record of managing substantial media budgets and explaining how investment decisions supported business results.

title: Buyer
description:
**Who We Are:** At Three Bird Nest, we are looking for people with a strong work ethic who are motivated to be part of a hardworking and dedicated team. Three Bird Nest's mission is "To inspire you to discover and express your authentic self through style." We look to our team to help us drive our mission and bring our customers a brand they can resonate with, from the Boho styles we select, the way we package and ship out our product, and the customer experience we provide. Each department has a hand in who we are as a company. We strive to have a workplace that lives our company's core values of being authentic, providing our customers with a boutique experience, creating a sense of community, and encouraging creativity. If you are looking for a company focused on building an engaging and team-oriented culture, Three Bird Nest might be the place for you.

**Role Summary**

The Buyer owns and manages a defined group of product categories for Three Bird Nest, taking responsibility for the assortment, vendor relationships, purchasing, and ongoing performance of those categories. This role sets the strategy for assigned categories, makes buying decisions within approved budgets, and leads vendor negotiations, partnering with the Director of Merchandising to build a cohesive assortment across all product categories.

The Buyer is responsible for understanding customer needs, identifying product opportunities, developing and maintaining vendor relationships, evaluating product performance, and making data-informed recommendations and buying decisions within their assigned categories. The role combines commercial ownership, analytical thinking, vendor management, tactical support, and strong execution to build profitable assortments that align with the Three Bird Nest customer and overall brand strategy.

This is a full-time role for an experienced buyer with a proven record of owning categories and delivering results. Success in this role requires strong commercial judgment, the confidence to make and stand behind decisions, the ability to manage multiple priorities, and a willingness to guide and develop Associate and Assistant Buyers as the team grows.

**Key ResponsibilitiesCategory Ownership & Buying**

· Set and define the buying and merchandising strategy for assigned categories, with accountability for assortment quality, product performance, inventory health, and sales results.

· Maintain a deep understanding of the Three Bird Nest customer, competitive landscape, and market trends, and use it to define where each category should grow, edit, or evolve.

· Independently identify new product opportunities and make recommendations for assortment additions, product extensions, colors, styles, and depth of buy within assigned categories.

· Plan and manage assortments for seasonal launches, balancing customer demand, trends, product productivity, pricing, inventory considerations, and overall category objectives.

· Evaluate sales and inventory performance and adjust future buying decisions based on business results.

· Identify category opportunities and risks throughout the season and proactively recommend actions to capitalize on opportunities or mitigate risk.

· Accountable for all category-level performance. Lead regular performance reviews with the Director of Merchandising covering sales results, key insights & learnings and the actions go forward.

**Vendor Management & Product Acquisition**

· Own day-to-day relationships with all vendors and serve as a primary point of contact for product selection, acquisition, pricing, and order management.

· Source, evaluate, and onboard new vendors that align with the Three Bird Nest customer, brand, and category strategy.

· Negotiate and communicate with vendors regarding product opportunities, pricing, availability, development, and timing.

· Work with vendors to expand successful products through new colors, styles, variations, and assortment breadth.

· Manage the product acquisition process for assigned categories from initial opportunity through launch.

· Contribute to strategic vendor opportunities across the broader business in partnership with the Director of Merchandising.

**Product Analytics & Business Management**

· Analyze sales, inventory, pricing, product attributes, and other relevant performance data to inform buying and assortment decisions.

· Translate business and customer insights into actionable recommendations for current and future assortments.

· Monitor category performance against sales and inventory expectations and proactively identify areas requiring action.

· Use historical performance and current business trends to inform product selection, quantities, timing, and assortment decisions.

· Maintain a strong understanding of category economics and the factors that drive product productivity and profitability.

· Ensure product, vendor, and order information is accurate and current within company systems.

**Purchasing & Product Lifecycle Management**

· Own purchasing and order placement for assigned categories, ensuring buys align with assortment strategy, demand, inventory objectives, and launch timing.

· Oversee purchase orders and manage post-PO communication, scheduling, and follow-up with vendors.

· Monitor product development and launch timelines and proactively address issues that could impact product availability or launch dates.

· Partner with Inventory Planning and Procurement to manage inventory flow and ensure products arrive in line with business needs.

· Review existing product performance and make recommendations regarding reorder opportunities, product extensions, assortment changes, and product exits.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

· Partner with Marketing, Creative, Site, Ecommerce, Inventory Planning, Procurement, and other teams to bring category assortments to market successfully.

· Set category priorities for marketing, site merchandising, creative, and promotional initiatives, identifying the key products and stories to support each season.

· Provide product and category insights to support marketing, site merchandising, creative, and promotional initiatives.

· Model buying best practices and help build team processes, tools, and standards as the department grows.

· Collaborate with the Director of Merchandising to ensure category decisions support the broader Three Bird Nest assortment and company strategy.

Partnership with the Director of Merchandising

· Operate as the owner of assigned categories while partnering with the Director of Merchandising on overall buying strategy, business priorities, and major seasonal initiatives.

· Bring forward recommendations, ideas, risks, and opportunities proactively rather than waiting for direction.

· Provide category-level insights and recommendations that contribute to broader department strategy and decision-making.

· Partner with the Director of Merchandising on major seasonal initiatives, strategic vendor opportunities, and cross-category projects.

**Qualifications**

· Bachelor’s degree in Fashion, Business, Merchandising, or a related field preferred.

· 4-6 years of experience in buying, retail merchandising, product development, or a related vendor-facing role, including 2 years with direct ownership of a category; women’s apparel or accessories experience preferred.

· Proven record of growing a category through sales, margin, or sell-through results.

· Demonstrated ability to independently manage products, categories, vendors, or comparable areas of responsibility.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use business data to make recommendations and decisions.

· Strong understanding of assortment planning, product performance, inventory, pricing, and retail buying fundamentals. Experience building and managing open-to-buy, buy plans, and margin targets.

· Strong product aesthetic, taste level, and customer lens, with a proven eye for curation and styling.

· Confident, professional communication skills with vendors and cross-functional partners.

· Highly organized with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and projects.

· Proficiency with Google Suite, Excel, and Claude, and familiarity with Shopify, ShipHero, Canva, or comparable systems preferred.

· Strong attention to detail without losing sight of broader business objectives.

· Curious, proactive, and comfortable making recommendations and taking ownership in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

**Living Our Core Values**

In everything this role touches, we look for our four core values: Authenticity in every selection and recommendation, the Boutique Experience of trust and personal attention, a real sense of Community with and among our customers, and Creativity that brings originality and artistry to every part of the business.

description:
**Director of Marketing**

**Job Description**

The Acceleration Project (TAP) is a nonprofit that empowers under-resourced small business owners to accelerate their growth through high-impact, customized training and support. TAP is at an inflection point, with growing corporate and foundation partnerships, geographic expansion, a new digital community platform, and an ambitious plan to dramatically scale our reach over the next five years.

Since 2012, TAP has supported more than 18,000 owners across 48 states and delivered over 70,000 hours of pro bono consulting, generating a validated 10:1 social return on investment. Behind those numbers are entrepreneurs building stronger businesses, supporting their families, and strengthening their communities.

Beyond the numbers are individuals, families, and communities that thrive when small businesses succeed. Fifty percent of small business owners fail within the first five years - many Americans have felt this fallout personally. TAP is on a mission to safeguard the incredibly viable, potent, and delicate pathway to economic mobility that small business ownership affords. We have expanded our funding, our reach, and our impact, and are excited to be growing our team at this critical moment for our mission.

**We have the story and data to continue making our presence felt in the small business ecosystem, you’ll bring the vision, creativity, and rigor to help us get there**

**Role Overview**

TAP has a powerful story. We’re looking for a Director of Marketing to bring it to more people and inspire them to act.

You’ll shape TAP’s brand and lead campaigns that help small business owners find support, inspire volunteer consultants to join our mission, and engage partners and donors in expanding our impact.

You’ll own the marketing plan, content calendar, and day-to-day execution, bringing strong writing, creative thinking, and analytical judgment to the work. You’ll collaborate across TAP and manage external resources as applicable.

Reporting to the Executive Director and working closely with the Chief Revenue Officer and CEO, this is a full-time, remote-first role with occasional meetings and events in the New York City metropolitan area.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Marketing Strategy & Campaigns:** Develop and execute TAP’s marketing plan with the CEO, ED, and CRO, prioritizing donor engagement and fundraising while supporting partnerships, client acquisition, and consultant recruitment.

* **Digital Marketing & Discoverability:** Manage email, social, and website marketing, using search engine optimization (SEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO) to help audiences discover TAP through search and AI tools.
* **Data Analysis & Performance:** Use Google Analytics, UTM tracking, and campaign data to understand audience behavior, measure conversions, and improve marketing results.
* **AI & Innovation:** Apply AI to improve marketing workflows and personalization; stay curious about emerging trends and test promising approaches to expand TAP’s reach and effectiveness.
* **Planning & Resource Management:** Own the marketing calendar, coordinate across teams, and manage agencies, contractors, and spending within approved budgets.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
* 3–5 years of marketing or communications experience, with demonstrated results leading campaigns from strategy through execution and measurement across multiple audiences.
* Strong copywriting and editing skills, with a talent for turning stories and data into compelling messages that inspire action.
* Hands-on experience creating and managing email, social media, website content, and digital campaigns.
* Proficiency with Canva or similar design tools and a strong eye for visual storytelling and brand consistency.
* An organized approach to building marketing workflows and moving audiences from initial interest to engagement, giving, or participation.
* Experience using Google Analytics, UTM tracking, and campaign data to test ideas, understand results, and improve performance.
* Practical experience with AI marketing tools and curiosity about emerging trends, including search engine optimization (SEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO).
* Initiative, sound judgment, and a collaborative approach to managing competing priorities on a lean, remote-first team.
* A commitment to expanding economic opportunity for under-resourced small business owners.

**What You’ll Gain**

* **Make Your Mark:** Shape TAP’s marketing direction, bring your ideas to life, and work directly with senior leadership.
* **Build What’s Next:** Put your creativity, data skills, and emerging marketing tools to work as TAP expands nationally.
* **Grow Your Experience:** Build strategic, creative, and leadership skills while leading campaigns across donor engagement, client outreach, consultant recruitment, and partnerships.
* **See Your Impact:** Connect your work to stronger small businesses, greater economic opportunity, and thriving communities across the country.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Salary: $70,000-75,000, commensurate with experience
* Generous PTO + 10 paid holidays + 2 floating holidays
* Time off between Christmas and New Year’s
* Health and dental insurance
* 403(b) retirement plan

**How to Apply**

Submit your resume and cover letter to **careers@theaccelerationproject.org** with “Director of Marketing” in the subject line.

In your cover letter, please tell us:

* Why you’re interested in this role and in TAP’s mission
* About a campaign you ran, with the results it achieved
* Which of our four audiences (clients, consultants, partners, or donors) you’d start with, and how you’d reach them

We prohibit discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other legally protected status.*

title: Content Production Director
description:
**About Us**

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

**About The Role**

Chess.com is building a media organization around chess: original shows, documentaries, creator-led programming, video, and live broadcasts that bring more people into the game and keep them here. Media & Content now has five teams: International, Social and Audience Growth, Content Production, IRL Events, and Broadcast.

Content Production makes the shows that tell our stories. As its head, you will set the strategy, the creative bar, and the production standards for the group, and our existing video, editorial, and production teams will report to you. You will also shape how the team is organized as the slate grows.

**About You**

You are the person who turns great ideas into finished content.

You came up through production, so you know how to tell an amazing story and what it takes to get it finished. Whether it’s a live broadcast, a studio show, a one-off docu-style video, or a brand-new IP idea that would thrive on YouTube, you understand how creative, editorial, post, talent, and distribution all need to work together. Somewhere along the way, you also discovered you’re just as good at seeing the whole picture, setting the direction, and getting a big team moving toward the same outcome as you are in the weeds of things.

You have strong creative instincts and real taste. You can protect what makes an idea special while still making it deliverable. You know when to push for something better, when to simplify, and when someone just needs to make the call.

You are in touch with the community. You know what chess fans, gamers, and creators are watching, what they love, and what they're tired of. You make content that feels like it was made by someone who is part of that world, because you are.

You are comfortable leading managers and holding the slate, the budget, and the schedule. When a shoot falls through, a creator's calendar changes, and a cut needs to ship by Friday, you solve the problem without losing sight of why the project exists.

You are equally comfortable building a multi-year content strategy and sitting in an edit bay giving notes. You have high standards, good judgment, a low ego, and the ability to stay calm when the plan changes.

**What you'll do**

* **Set our content production strategy.** Build a clear long-term vision for our slate of shows, series, documentaries, and creator collaborations, and define how each one drives audience growth, community, brand, and the path from watching to playing.
* **Own the slate.** Create an annual roadmap across franchises, new formats, and one-off projects. Make smart decisions about where to invest, what to grow, and what to stop making.
* **Lead and develop the team.** Manage managers and individual contributors across production, editing, and creative. Set clear lanes, ownership, and decision rights, and build a team that makes strong calls without waiting for you.
* **Set the creative bar.** Own the quality of what we put out. Give clear, specific feedback, protect the strongest ideas, and know when something is ready to ship.
* **Own production operations.** Build and hold the production calendar, budgets, vendor relationships, and delivery standards. Know where a project is at risk before it slips.
* **Stay close to the community.** Follow what's working on YouTube, Twitch, Discord, Reddit, and Chess.com itself, and turn that into content decisions. Keep the work true to how chess fans actually talk and watch.
* **Work with creators and talent.** Be a trusted partner to creators, players, and personalities. Bring their ideas and audience insight into what we make, and set them up to do their best work.
* **Partner across Media & Content.** Work with Social and Audience Growth to make content built for how people watch, with Broadcast and IRL Events to share formats, assets, and talent, and with International to make what we create work globally.
* **Define what success looks like.** Measure content across viewership, audience growth, engagement, brand impact, and conversion to play. Use those insights to make each project better than the last.
* **Build our operating system.** Establish the tools, roles, approval processes, budget models, and post-project reviews that let us make bigger and better content with less friction each year.
* **Explore what comes next.** Evaluate new formats, platforms, and technology, including AI, where they improve speed or quality without flattening our voice.

**Must-Have Skills**

* More than 10 years of experience in content production across digital video, entertainment, gaming, sports, or media, with a track record of shipping work people watched.
* A hands-on production background. You have produced, directed, or run production on shows, series, or documentaries and understand the craft from development through post and delivery.
* More than 5 years of experience leading teams, including managers. You have built teams, hired well, handled performance issues, and developed people.
* The ability to move comfortably between long-term strategy, executive communication, and detailed delivery.
* Strong creative judgment and the production experience to know what is possible, what needs to change, and what is worth fighting for.
* A genuine connection to community and fandom, and the instinct to make content that resonates with it.
* Experience working with creators and talent, and respect for how they work and what their audiences expect.
* A track record of owning production budgets, including forecasting, vendor negotiation, and contracting.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to create alignment in a fully distributed company.
* Calm and decisive leadership when conditions change and information is incomplete.
* A strong sense of ownership and genuine care for the people doing the work.

**Nice-To-Have Skills**

* Experience in esports, gaming, sports, music, or creator-driven media.
* Experience with documentary or long-form episodic storytelling.
* Experience building or scaling a content team inside a fast-growing digital company.
* Experience producing across multiple languages or regions.
* An understanding of how content, broadcast, social, creators, live events, and community growth work together.
* You do not need to be a strong chess player. You do need to be curious about why hundreds of millions of people love this game and excited about creating new ways for them to experience it.

**About the Opportunity**

* This is a Full-Time opportunity
* We are 100% remote (work from anywhere!)
* This role is open to candidates who can work in USA, CAN, UK, or ES (preferably)

title: Director, Product Design
description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

As Director of Product Design, you will lead the design organization responsible for how customers and administrators experience Menlo Security's Enterprise Secure Browser platform, from the first-run configuration dashboard experience to the policies that keep global enterprises safe. You will set the design philosophy, user and administrator dashboards quality bar, and research and accessibility standards for the entire product organization, and build the team, tooling, and operating rhythms that make excellent work the default. Partnering closely with VP-level leaders across Product, Engineering, Data, and Go-to-Market, you will make design a strategic driver of product direction and competitive differentiation in enterprise security, where clarity and trust matter as much as capability. You will also lead how the design team utilizes AI,how we leverage AI to continue to improve our user interfaces, and build shared workflows that speed up research synthesis, exploration, and quality review while keeping human judgment at the center.

**Outcomes & KPIs**
-------------------

**Key Outcome(s) Owned:**

* A consistently high-quality, accessible, and cohesive product experience across all Menlo surfaces that measurably improves customer adoption, satisfaction, and retention.
* A high-performing, well-led design organization with the systems, standards, and talent to scale with the business.

**Success Metrics / KPIs:** *(suggested; hiring manager to confirm)*

* Improvement in product usability and customer satisfaction measures (e.g., task success rates, SUS/CSAT, or NPS for key workflows) year over year.
* Accessibility conformance (e.g., WCAG 2.2 AA) across core product surfaces, tracked through defined quality gates.
* Design system adoption and consistency across product teams, along with fewer design-related defects reaching production.
* Measurable time saved or quality improved through AI-enabled design workflows adopted across the team.
* Team health and growth indicators, including engagement scores, retention of top talent, and internal promotion readiness.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead, grow, and coach a team of product designers and design managers, investing meaningful time in talent development, setting clear performance expectations, and making timely talent decisions.
* Define the craft philosophy, quality standards, and review processes that govern interaction design, visual design, and accessibility across the full product organization, and build the design systems and frameworks that sustain them at scale.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, and Go-to-Market leaders to shape multi-quarter and multi-year product vision, influence roadmap and investment decisions, and protect design intent through implementation.
* Establish the organization's research and accessibility practice, embedding evidence-based decision-making and company-wide accessibility standards into roadmap planning and product quality gates.
* Demonstrate design's business impact through outcome tracking and clear business cases, and represent design strategy and results at the VP and executive level.
* Design and scale AI-enabled workflows for the team, such as using AI to synthesize research and customer feedback, generate and explore early concepts, and support accessibility and consistency checks, and evaluate AI tools for fit, risk, and ROI.
* Build cross-functional forums and operating rhythms that bring the customer's perspective into how Menlo plans, prioritizes, and makes decisions.

**Functional Competencies**
---------------------------

**Required:**

* 12+ years of product design experience, including 5+ years leading design teams with managers reporting to you, ideally in B2B or enterprise SaaS.
* A portfolio showing advanced craft in UX, interaction, and visual design for complex products, and how you have raised quality standards across multiple teams.
* Experience building or scaling a design system and establishing design review and quality processes across a product organization.
* Depth in user research methods and accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG), with a track record of embedding both into product decisions.
* Proven ability to influence executive and C-suite stakeholders, connect design work to business outcomes, and shape product strategy and roadmaps.
* Hands-on fluency with AI tools in design and research workflows, with experience guiding a team's adoption of them responsibly.

**Preferred / Nice to Have:**

* Experience designing for cybersecurity, networking, or IT/security administrator audiences.
* Experience designing AI-powered or agentic product experiences.
* Experience leading content design or UX writing alongside product design.
* External presence in the design community, such as speaking, writing, or mentoring.
* Bachelor's degree in design, HCI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Menlo Mindsets**
------------------

The Menlo Mindsets serve as our strategic operating system, directly linking our daily behaviors to the business results we need to achieve by defining exactly "how" we do our work. By establishing this clear, shared standard, they empower our most successful employees to consistently drive the innovation and accountability required for our long-term success.

* **Proactive Leadership** — I do not settle for the status quo. I take ownership, make informed decisions, and proactively communicate to drive results while empowering others to do the same.
* **Straight Talk** — I share honestly and transparently, actively seeking diverse perspectives while encouraging the same.
* **United Impact** — I break down barriers to champion cross-functional collaboration, uniting diverse strengths with clear ownership to drive exceptional, aligned outcomes.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You align with Product, Engineering, and GTM leaders on shared priorities and build the forums that make design quality a company-wide responsibility, not just the design team's.
* **Elevated Talent** — I believe talent is our differentiator, upholding a high bar for performance and leadership and continuous development.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You spend real time developing designers and design managers, set a clear bar for craft and leadership, and know and actively grow the top talent across your organization.
* **Customer-Compelled** — Customer focus is my mission. I own their experience, prevent their challenges, and act with urgency to deliver value.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You bring research and customer insight into strategic planning, and work across teams to find and remove root-cause friction in the product before customers feel it.

Follow us on LinkedIn!

**Why Menlo?**

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: **Proactive Leadership**, **Straight Talk**, **United Impact**, **Elevated Talent**, and **Customer-Compelled**. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability**.

Agencies must have a valid services agreement executed and must have been assigned by the Talent team to a specific requisition. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. In the event a candidate submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment will be paid.***
